title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events
Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline relevant to environmental sustainability, such as: industrial ecology, environmental engineering, environmental or ecological economics or computational social science
• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

Experience and skills

description:
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise spanning the natural, built and industrial environments, as well as space, artificial intelligence, security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to develop solutions to real-world challenges and deliver positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

About the Functional Polymeric and Particulate Materials Unit

The Functional Polymeric and Particulate Materials Unit develops advanced polymeric and particulate materials through synthesis, formulation, processing, characterisation and modelling. Its research focuses on designing high-performance, multifunctional and sustainable materials for applications in sectors such as mobility, construction, energy and healthcare.
The Unit contributes to national and European research and innovation ecosystems by securing competitive funding and developing collaborative projects with industry.
Its main research and innovation priorities include:
• Designing thermoplastics, thermosets, elastomers, nanocomposites and polyelectrolytes with advanced functionality, high performance, enhanced safety and improved sustainability.
• Valorising alternative feedstocks, including lignocellulosic biomass and waste materials, to produce monomers, polymers, additives and particles.
• Developing safe reprocessing and advanced manufacturing technologies, including additive manufacturing, 3D/4D printing and reactive extrusion, to create new materials and components and manage their end-of-life effectively.
• Advancing the fundamental understanding of the structure, viscoelastic, mechanical and tribological performance, and transport behaviour of polymeric materials and nanocomposites through polymer physics, advanced characterisation, molecular modelling, machine learning and artificial intelligence.

How will you contribute?

Working closely with the Science Director, the Valorisation Director and LIST's senior management, the Head of Unit will define and implement the Unit's scientific, innovation and business strategy. The successful candidate will lead several research groups, oversee the Unit's budget and project portfolio, secure competitive and industry funding, and ensure the delivery of high-quality scientific and technological outcomes.
The Head of Unit will be an established scientific and organisational leader with extensive experience in managing multidisciplinary research activities. They will represent LIST among key institutional, academic, industrial and policy stakeholders and strengthen the Unit's position within national and international research and innovation ecosystems.
Among others your duties may include:
• Define and implement the Unit's scientific, innovation and business strategy in alignment with LIST's strategic priorities.
• Translate the Unit's strategy into clear objectives, operational plans and roadmaps, and monitor progress against agreed targets.
• Lead, support and develop the Unit's group leaders and multidisciplinary teams, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance.

employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

title: Technico-commercial(e) (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches :


CDI – Temps partiel – Luxembourg

Dans le cadre de son développement au Luxembourg, Aqua Purify recherche un(e) technico-commercial(e) capable d'assurer à la fois le développement commercial, le conseil technique et le suivi de nos clients particuliers et professionnels.

Le poste s'adresse à une personne autonome, organisée, à l'aise avec la clientèle et disposant de bonnes connaissances techniques dans le domaine de la mécanique du bâtiment.


Vos missions:

Vous intervenez sur l'ensemble du territoire luxembourgeois et prenez en charge notamment :

• Le traitement des demandes et leads entrants ;
• La prospection de nouveaux clients B2C et B2B ;
• Les visites techniques et commerciales chez les clients  
• L'analyse des besoins et la recommandation de solutions adaptées ;
• La réalisation des offres et devis ;
• La présentation des solutions et le closing des ventes ;
• Le suivi commercial des clients et prospects ;
• La mise en service des équipements ;
• Les opérations d'entretien et de maintenance ;
• Les premiers diagnostics et dépannages ;
• Le support technique et l'accompagnement des clients ;
• La manutention et le port occasionnel de charges lourdes liés aux équipements et consommables.


Profil recherché:

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne ayant une bonne compréhension des équipements techniques du bâtiment.
Une expérience ou des connaissances dans l'un des domaines suivants constituent un réel avantage : plomberie, chauffage, HVAC, sanitaire, pompage, filtration ou équipements techniques du bâtiment.
Une expérience spécifique dans le traitement de l'eau est appréciée mais n'est pas indispensable : une formation aux produits et solutions Aqua Purify sera assurée.


Vous devez notamment disposer :

• De bonnes connaissances en mécanique du bâtiment ;
• D'un réel sens commercial et du service client ;
• D'une capacité à comprendre rapidement un besoin technique ;
• D'autonomie et d'un bon sens de l'organisation ;
• D'une bonne capacité à communiquer et à conseiller ;
• D'une capacité physique compatible avec le port occasionnel de charges lourdes ;
• D'un permis de conduire valide ;
• D'un casier judiciaire compatible avec les fonctions exercées.

Un extrait de casier judiciaire pourra être demandé dans le cadre du processus de recrutement.


Ce que nous proposons:

• CDI à temps partiel ;
• Prise de fonction immédiate ;
• Période d'essai ;
• Salaire fixe adapté à l'expérience et au profil ;
• Commissions sur les ventes réalisées ;
• Véhicule de société ;
• Téléphone professionnel ;
• Ordinateur portable ;
• Formation aux produits et aux technologies de traitement de l'eau ;
• Autonomie importante dans l'organisation de l'activité ;

Aqua Purify développe des solutions de traitement et d'amélioration de la qualité de l'eau pour les particuliers et les professionnels au Luxembourg.
Notre activité couvre notamment l'adoucissement de l'eau, la filtration, l'osmose inverse et différentes solutions destinées à protéger les installations, améliorer la qualité de l'eau et répondre aux problématiques spécifiques rencontrées chez nos clients.
Nous recherchons une personne souhaitant s'impliquer durablement dans le développement de notre activité au Luxembourg.

title: Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière (m/f)
description:
Description:

Notre client est un acteur reconnu de la promotion immobilière au Luxembourg, adossé à un groupe européen de référence dans les domaines de la construction et du développement immobilier. Dans le cadre de son développement, nous recrutons son/sa futur(e) Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière pour piloter l'activité luxembourgeoise.
S'appuyant sur un portefeuille de projets résidentiels et tertiaires déjà sécurisé pour les prochaines années, vous prendrez la responsabilité du développement de l'activité, du pilotage des opérations et du management des équipes, avec une large autonomie et le soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos responsabilités

En tant que Directeur/trice d'une Agence de Promotion Immobilière, vous assurez le pilotage global de l'entité, tant sur les aspects stratégiques qu'opérationnels.

Développement de l'activité

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de développement de l'activité au Luxembourg.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités et développer un réseau de partenaires (investisseurs, propriétaires, architectes, bureaux d'études, collectivités, clients...).
• Contribuer au développement commercial et à la commercialisation des opérations.
• Représenter l'entreprise auprès des principaux acteurs du marché immobilier luxembourgeois.

Pilotage des opérations

• Superviser les projets immobiliers, de la faisabilité jusqu'à la livraison.
• Garantir le respect des objectifs de qualité, de délais, de coûts et de rentabilité.
• Piloter les procédures administratives et réglementaires propres au Luxembourg (PAP, autorisations de construire, etc.).
• Coordonner les équipes internes et les partenaires externes afin d'assurer le bon déroulement des opérations.

Gestion de l'activité

• Piloter l'entité comme un véritable centre de profit.
• Assurer le suivi financier des opérations, analyser les montages et accompagner les décisions d'investissement.
• Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction Générale.

Management

• Manager et accompagner une équipe d'une petite dizaine de collaborateurs (Responsables de Projets, spécialistes techniques et fonctions administratives).
• Coordonner les intervenants externes (architectes, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle et autres partenaires).
• Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et accompagner le développement de l'activité.

Votre profil

Vous évoluez depuis plusieurs années dans le secteur immobilier luxembourgeois et disposez d'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la promotion immobilière. Votre parcours vous a permis d'acquérir une vision globale d'une opération immobilière, que ce soit au sein d'un promoteur immobilier ou à travers des fonctions de pilotage de projets complexes dans le secteur de la construction ou du développement immobilier.

Vous maîtrisez notamment:

• L'ensemble du processus de promotion immobilière, de l'acquisition foncière à la livraison des opérations.
• Les montages financiers et le pilotage économique de projets immobiliers.
• La gestion d'un centre de profit ou d'une activité disposant d'objectifs financiers.
• Les procédures administratives luxembourgeoises, notamment les PAP, les autorisations de construire et les relations avec les administrations.
• La commercialisation de programmes immobiliers et la relation avec les différents partenaires du projet.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité à fédérer les équipes, à prendre des décisions et à faire avancer les projets. Vous appréciez évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial où autonomie, vision stratégique et pragmatisme sont essentiels.
Le français et l'anglais sont indispensables. La maîtrise du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer:  Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. title: Senior Program Manager, Secure Network Design, WWOS Global Solution (m/f)
description:
Senior Program Manager, Secure Network Design, WWOS Global Solution
Job ID: 10530871 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The Program Manager, Secure Network Design support the End-to-End Secure Network (E2ESN) organization within World Wide Operations Security WWOS, driving programs that create Earth's most reliably secure supply chain through prevention, intervention, and investigation. This role combines Amazon's core program management competencies with domain-specific expertise to architect, plan, and secure Amazon's global transportation network across supply chain miles – Global Mile, First Mile and Middle Mile OTR. Team apply the "Shift-Left" principle to engineer resilience into the network design architecture itself, building a capability that prevents incidents by design rather than chasing them after the fact.

Key job responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

- Owns the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across organizations or geographies
- Define program scope, goals, success criteria, and inputs/outputs metrics in collaboration with stakeholders
- Develop and maintain program roadmaps, glidepaths, and work-back schedules aligned to OP planning cycles
- Drive mechanisms (WBRs, MBRs, portfolio reviews) to track progress vs. plan and surface risks early
- Accountable for overall program strategy and tactically driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver

Secure Network Design

- Architect a Secure-by-Design Transportation Network, embed security principles into network design decisions where security becomes a primary design variable alongside cost, speed, and service level.
- Defines secured network path strategies that ensure that theft and loss are structurally designed out through preventive architecture before they materialize
- Enable actionable intelligence that drives systematic improvements across the network
- Measure adoption rates and alignment metrics for deployed solutions
- Leverage AI-driven decision support and ensure investments are focused on the most at-risk vulnerabilities for maximum impact

Stakeholder Management & Influence

- Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Tech, Legal, and WWOS teams - Field Loss Prevention, Investigation teams.
- Facilitate alignment across AMER and INTL regional teams to ensure consistent solution deployment and best practices adoption
- Represent program status and strategic direction in leadership reviews
- Serve as the bridge between E2ESN Solutions teams and partner teams
- Build and maintain relationships with partner organizations

Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and escalate appropriately through WWOS governance
- Manage dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams
- Makes appropriate trade-offs to optimize timelines and deliverables in consultation with stakeholders
- Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and mechanism design
- Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for program operations

Data & Analytics Stewardship

- Own program-level data quality, ensuring accurate $ loss / entitlement attribution by supply chain segment
- Partner with Data Services teams for dashboard development and automated network coverage tracking
- Parter with Finance team to drive theft/loss estimates using statistical models
- Support AI/ML integration into security solutions to reduce manual investigative burden

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to collaborate and lead in a flexible, detail-oriented, fast-paced team environment
- Demonstrated ability to independently use AI tools in daily work, integrating them into program workflows to drive better outcomes, and guiding others on effective adoption

Preferred Qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
- Six-Sigma or equivalent certification
- Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
- ISO 28000 (Supply Chain Security Management System) or TAPA (Transported Asset Protection Association) certification
- Experience with supply chain security frameworks (ASIS, AIBM-CSCRM)

title: Solution Architect I - Subsidy Projects (fixed-term 24 months) (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:


Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation.
LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner.
The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services.
Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.
www.lnds.lu | LNDS on LinkedIn


Purpose of the job / project

Help design and deliver the data infrastructure that Luxembourg and its European partners rely on for secure, lawful access to sensitive data. You will work alongside senior architects on real systems with real deadlines and take on your own architectural scope as you go.

This is a fixed-term position of 24 months, created to meet a sustained increase in architecture work across our EU project portfolio.
You will work on one or more projects from that portfolio — currently including STORE-1PLUSMG, USE-1PLUSMG, SCAILED, the European Compliance Stack, DDSSC2, COOPAIFA and PANDAI — with assignments set by portfolio priorities and evolving as projects start and close.
We are looking for a Solution Architect to help design and deliver secure, large-scale data infrastructure, working alongside our senior architects.
You will consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers and partner organisations and translate them into architecture documentation.
You will contribute to the specification, configuration, integration, and technical validation of the components behind our data services.
Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC, you will help build the data solutions our partners across Europe depend on.


What you will do

Architecture design and documentation

Learn and deliver the core architecture artefacts, starting from established LNDS patterns and templates, and taking on more of the design work as your experience grows.
Maintain the architecture documentation set across assigned projects — keeping it current, internally consistent and ready for formal review. Several projects require successive versioned releases approved at fixed milestones.

Requirements and analysis

Support senior architects in gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.
Analyse and document business constraints.

Implementation support

Work with engineering and operations colleagues to turn architecture into working systems.
Support the specification, configuration, and integration of components.
Support technical validation and acceptance activities, including preparing test scenarios and evidence.

Standards, compliance and quality

Learn, adopt and apply LNDS architectural standards, patterns and review practices consistently, and flag where they do not fit.
Support the implementation of technical and organisational measures under Data Protection by Design and Default, working with Legal and data governance colleagues.

Project and consortium contribution

Contribute to project deliverables and milestones, tracking your own commitments and raising slippage early.
Support proposal preparation with technical input and effort estimation.


Who you are

BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing.
1-2 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems.
Working knowledge of distributed systems, APIs and integration patterns, databases, and data modelling.
Exposure with cloud or container platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipelines.
Foundational understanding of information security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, and network segmentation.
Able to write clear technical documentation and produce readable diagrams.
Awareness of GDPR and the broader EU data regulatory landscape.
Familiarity with agile delivery practices.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Curious, methodical, and comfortable speaking when you do not understand something.
Willingness to learn architectural concepts and methods, and to develop your information security and regulatory knowledge seriously.
Collaborative, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
Interest in health data, genomics, data spaces or public sector data infrastructure.
Prior experience in EU-funded projects is a plus.


About us

What we offer

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking.
We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission.
We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies.
Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character.
Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values.
We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact.
Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative.
Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and specification of large-scale federated data infrastructure, with a particular emphasis on data spaces.
You will lead the design of solution architectures end to end, from requirements through to delivery support. You will contribute to and produce reference architectures, blueprints and interoperability profiles to support implementation by partner organisations across Europe. You will lead work packages where LNDS holds that responsibility and represent us in multi-partner consortia. Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC.

Solution design and architecture

Design and own end-to-end solution architectures for assigned projects, covering system context, component and interface definition, data flows, storage strategy, protocols and tooling.
Define non-functional requirements with the same rigor as functional ones: security, interoperability, scalability, availability, accountability, and auditability.
Establish and maintain technical and organizational measures frameworks under Data Protection by Design and Default.

Specification, procurement and conformance

Gather and consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.

Able to move between several projects with competing demands and prioritise without dropping commitments.
Collaborative and adaptable, and effective in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.

Direct experience implementing or contributing to a data space framework (Gaia-X, IDSA, DSSC Blueprint) is a plus.

Manage project implementation, including communication with external project partnerships
Follow and manage project timelines, identify implementation risks, issues and conflicts, and work on solutions
Prepare, coordinateand submit monitoring reports to responsible managing authorities
Manage communication with third parties and stakeholders during project implementation, including project meetings and events
Coordinate the preparation and timely submission of deliverables, ensuring their completeness and compliance with project requirements
Support applications, technical proposals, and budget planning under EC and national research and innovation programmes
Contribute to project management frameworks and support their implementation Provide guidance on project management processes and tools to internal teams and partners, as needed
Provide guidance to less experienced team members


Who you are

Required

MSc or PhD in natural science, technology or social science with technical skills
5 to 10 years of relevant experience in technical project management
At least 3 years' of experience in managing national and European Union (EU)-level innovation projects
Good knowledge command of office software (MS Excel, Word, SharePoint, Power BI, Google Workspace, Webex/Teams & other collaboration tools)
Excellent command of project management tools (e.g. Jira or similar)
Good knowledge and experience in Agile methodologies and organisations (SAFe in particular)
Excellent verbal communication skills in English
Excellent writing skills (documentation, reports, etc.)
Travel availability (Schengen and non-Schengen, 2-3 times a year)
Responsibility, consistency, and adherence to strict deadlines
Administrative, organisational, and communication skills


Optional (considered as advantages)

Knowledge of project reporting (both technical and financial)
Knowledge of a second European language (especially German or French)
Received formal project management training or otherwise proven knowledge of project management methods
Basic understanding of GDPR in the research and development domain
Good working knowledge of a project management framework such as the PM2 methodology (https://www.pm2alliance.eu/)
Working knowledge of data processing tools
Working knowledge of Atlassian Solutions (e.g. Confluence, Jira Service Management)
Experience in managing EC projects in a coordinator's institute


About us

What we offer

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.


Apply now!

• Travailler dans un environnement dynamique grâce à une approche basée sur un dossier de soins informatisé à 100 %

title: Senior Risk Officer (m/f)
description:

title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

title: Assistant Manager –  Data analyst AML and FATCA/CRS (m/f)
description:
Role purpose

This role provides management reporting, business insights, regulatory reporting support and process improvement solutions for the Luxembourg AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS function. The Assistant Manager helps maintain a consolidated Luxembourg-wide view of risks across the client, investor and beneficial ownership population, supporting planning, performance monitoring, capacity management, local regulatory accountability and decision-making.

Working closely with operational teams and stakeholders, the role identifies opportunities to automate repetitive processes, improve data quality, strengthen controls and enhance reporting efficiency. It supports the production of regulatory information required by the CSSF, the Luxembourg tax authorities (AED) and, increasingly, AMLA, with AMLA-related requests already being received and processed by the function.
A significant portion of the information used by the role relates to highly confidential client, investor and beneficial ownership data. The role therefore requires direct Luxembourg access to the full data population, including clients and investors who have refused outsourcing arrangements or whose contractual confidentiality undertakings restrict data transfers outside Luxembourg, in addition to Luxembourg professional secrecy and GDPR requirements.

The role sits at the intersection of AML/KYC operations, governance, data analytics, AI and automation, ensuring that transformation initiatives remain aligned with Luxembourg regulatory requirements, client expectations and operational realities. Its primary purpose is oversight, data consolidation, quality challenge, management intelligence, regulatory reporting support and automation, rather than operational processing.

The role suits someone analytical and process-driven, who can turn complex data into clear business recommendations and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities (how we will measure success)

• Timely and accurate delivery of management reporting, dashboards and KPI packs to agreed deadlines;
• Reporting outputs that stakeholders actively use to monitor performance, capacity and workload;
• Measurable efficiency gains from automating manual and repetitive reporting processes;
• Improved data quality and stronger reporting controls, with issues identified and resolved at source;
• Solving problems by providing innovative ideas in improving/developing internal systems to meet set objectives & maximise the team efficiency;
• Clear, actionable insights and recommendations that support planning and management decision-making.
• Effective consolidated Luxembourg-wide oversight of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks, including the full client and investor population relevant to local regulatory accountability;
• Reliable management information, data analytics and regulatory reporting support for Luxembourg management, RCs and Conducting Officers;

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis)

• Designing & implementing automated reporting processes and KPIs, using Excel (including VBA), Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform;
• Building and maintaining dashboards, management reporting packs, forecasts and capacity models for operational teams and senior management;
• Ability to create reports/presentations (data visualisation) to be delivered to internal stakeholders as well as to clients;
• Handling data management of the team and leading projects on data cleansing, data quality and reconciliation;
• Translating business requirements into scalable solutions across Excel, SharePoint, Power Platform and other business applications;
• Identifying and delivering process improvement and automation opportunities, including support for AI and automation initiatives;
• Analysing performance, capacity and workload trends, and turning the findings into clear recommendations for management;
• Documenting reporting processes, data sources and controls so that outputs are accurate, repeatable and auditable;
• Maintaining a consolidated Luxembourg-wide view of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks across the client, investor and beneficial ownership population and supporting the production of CSSF, AED and AMLA-related regulatory information;
• Providing Luxembourg management with a 360-degree view of relevant AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks through consolidated reporting, data analytics, quality challenge and management information;
• Challenging data gaps, inconsistencies and reporting issues at source, including through direct interaction with Luxembourg teams, clients, auditors, RCs, Conducting Officers and senior management;
• Ensuring that AI, automation and data transformation initiatives remain embedded within the business, close to Luxembourg decision-makers and aligned with regulatory requirements, client expectations and operational realities;
• Representing IQ-EQ Luxembourg and the AML/KYC function at AI-focused forums, industry roundtables and strategic discussions with key partners , including EY, PwC, law firms and other market stakeholders, to strengthen market presence, foster innovation, share industry insights and identify emerging opportunities;
• You will be required to respond to queries from our stakeholders (clients, colleagues, management), whether by telephone or in writing, in a timely and courteous manner;

Key competencies for position and level (see Group Competency model)

• Advanced Excel, including VBA
• Microsoft Power BI
• Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and SharePoint
• Data analysis and business insight
• Proficient use of AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude AI to support analysis, automation, drafting and productivity improvements
• Process improvement and automation mindset
• Understanding of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS regulatory reporting, Luxembourg professional secrecy, data confidentiality and outsourcing considerations;
• Action oriented
• Critical thinker
• Collaborates
• Drives result (time management, prioritise tasks & consistent in meeting deadlines)

Key behaviours we expect to see

In addition to demonstrating our Group Values (Authentic, Bold, and Collaborative), the role holder will be expected to demonstrate the following:

• Have excellent communications skills, verbal and written, including the ability to explain data and technical concepts to a non-technical audience;
• Attention to detail and good organisational skills;
• Have the ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities and develop the right attitude;
• Curiosity about new tools and ways of working, including automation and AI.
• Ability to operate with sound judgement when handling highly confidential information and when balancing regulatory, client, operational and transformation priorities;

Requirements

• Degree Holder in /Finance/Data Analytics/Business Administration or a related discipline,
• Minimum 3/4 years relevant working experience in management reporting, data analytics or business intelligence (preferably in financial services or fund administration);
• Demonstrable experience in dashboard development, reporting automation, process improvement and operational transformation;
• Strong IT skills (advanced Excel and VBA, Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, SharePoint and any other relevant qualification/knowledge);
• Experience with SQL or other data query tools would be considered as an advantage;
• Fluent in English, and French would be considered as an advantage.

title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
description:
Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

title: Junior AML/KYC Officer (m/f)
description:
Junior AML/KYC Officer

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

title: Clinical Research Associate (m/f)
description:
The Clinical Research Associate works at LIH's Clinical and Epidemiological Investigation Center.

She/He will:

• Coordinate clinical research projects according to the protocol, budget and fixed timelines.
• Supervise and assist regulatory submissions to health authorities including the national research ethics committee.
• Support private sponsors, researchers and investigators from other research institutions or hospitals in the set up
and conduct of clinical research projects.
• Ensure compliance with the applicable legal, administrative and regulatory requirements.
• Provide specific expertise and know-how in clinical research.
• Provide support to safety reporting and adverse events reporting.
• Monitor clinical trials and guarantee the quality of the scientific data collected during the study.

Key Accountabilities

Site coordination & monitoring accountabilities:

• Be the interface between the various partners involved in clinical research projects including clinicians and researchers.
• Conduct the regulatory submissions according to the applicable laws and obtain approvals.
• Set-up financial contracts and manage financial aspects during the projects.
• Monitor and coordinate clinical research activities at different sites both at a national and international level including study design activities, initiation with all involved partners, monitoring, safety reporting and data management.
• Collect data, report it in the CRF and check that the data entered is consistent with the medical record of each patient.
• Participate in the quality procedure (evaluation process, drafting procedures, etc.), implementation of SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and their validation process.
• Participate in European consortia and grant applications.
• Ensure on-site monitoring of clinical research projects at different sites, both nationally and internationally.

Data Management accountabilities:

• Contribute to the design, development, and review of eCRF forms, ensuring that fields, workflows, and edit checks are aligned with the study protocol and operational feasibility.
• Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of the electronic data capture (EDC) system by testing the eCRF, workflows, queries, and system functionalities before database go-live.
• Perform data review and data cleaning activities, including identifying data discrepancies, reviewing system-generated queries, and resolving issues in collaboration with investigators and Data Managers.
• Support database lock.

Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications

• Master's degree in the field of Medical/Health, Biomedical, or Life Sciences or Biology/Biotechnology related sciences.
• Certified clinical research training (DIU-FARC, DIU-TEC, etc.).
• At least 2 years of experience in the domain of clinical research (CRO, clinical trial unit or research centre, pharmaceutical industry) including a significant on-site monitoring experience.
• Experience in multi-center international clinical trials.
• Good understanding of EU and Luxembourg research regulation frameworks, including patient rights, data protection (GDPR), Clinical Trial Regulation (CTR), and procedures of the CA and EC.
• Familiarity with EU and international regulatory frameworks for clinical research, data protection, and the secondary use of data and samples (e.g. CTR, GDPR, ICH-GCP, MDR).
• Ability to interact positively with advisors and regulatory authorities.
• Independent and multidisciplinary team working abilities, meticulous, motivated, creative and scientifically innovative.
• Strong oral and written communication skills, be able of summarising ideas and prioritising.
• Language skills: Fluent in French and English. Any other commonly spoken language in Luxembourg such as Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish would be an added advantage.

Located in Luxembourg, LIH offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international and multilingual environment that values personal respect and professional achievement based on the highest intellectual and ethical standards. The remuneration for this position shall be based on qualification and experience.

Applications including a cover letter and a curriculum vitae should be sent before April 30, 2026 via our website

Business Development Manager

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation.
LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner.
The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services.
Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.
www.lnds.lu | LNDS on LinkedIn

Help design and deliver the data infrastructure that Luxembourg and its European partners rely on for secure, lawful access to sensitive data. You will work alongside senior architects on real systems with real deadlines and take on your own architectural scope as you go.

This is a fixed-term position of 24 months, created to meet a sustained increase in architecture work across our EU project portfolio.
You will work on one or more projects from that portfolio — currently including STORE-1PLUSMG, USE-1PLUSMG, SCAILED, the European Compliance Stack, DDSSC2, COOPAIFA and PANDAI — with assignments set by portfolio priorities and evolving as projects start and close.

You will consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers and partner organisations and translate them into architecture documentation.
You will contribute to the specification, configuration, integration, and technical validation of the components behind our data services.
Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC, you will help build the data solutions our partners across Europe depend on.


What you will do

Architecture design and documentation

Learn and deliver the core architecture artefacts, starting from established LNDS patterns and templates, and taking on more of the design work as your experience grows.
Maintain the architecture documentation set across assigned projects — keeping it current, internally consistent and ready for formal review. Several projects require successive versioned releases approved at fixed milestones.

Requirements and analysis

Support senior architects in gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.
Analyse and document business constraints.

Implementation support

Work with engineering and operations colleagues to turn architecture into working systems.
Support the specification, configuration, and integration of components.
Support technical validation and acceptance activities, including preparing test scenarios and evidence.

Standards, compliance and quality

Learn, adopt and apply LNDS architectural standards, patterns and review practices consistently, and flag where they do not fit.
Support the implementation of technical and organisational measures under Data Protection by Design and Default, working with Legal and data governance colleagues.

Project and consortium contribution

Contribute to project deliverables and milestones, tracking your own commitments and raising slippage early.
Support proposal preparation with technical input and effort estimation.


Who you are

BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing.
1-2 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems.
Working knowledge of distributed systems, APIs and integration patterns, databases, and data modelling.
Exposure with cloud or container platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipelines.
Foundational understanding of information security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, and network segmentation.
Able to write clear technical documentation and produce readable diagrams.
Awareness of GDPR and the broader EU data regulatory landscape.
Familiarity with agile delivery practices.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Curious, methodical, and comfortable speaking when you do not understand something.
Willingness to learn architectural concepts and methods, and to develop your information security and regulatory knowledge seriously.
Collaborative, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
Interest in health data, genomics, data spaces or public sector data infrastructure.
Prior experience in EU-funded projects is a plus.


About us

What we offer

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking.
We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission.
We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies.
Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character.
Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values.
We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!

Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.
