title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

title: Assistant Manager –  Data analyst AML and FATCA/CRS (m/f)
description:
Role purpose

This role provides management reporting, business insights, regulatory reporting support and process improvement solutions for the Luxembourg AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS function. The Assistant Manager helps maintain a consolidated Luxembourg-wide view of risks across the client, investor and beneficial ownership population, supporting planning, performance monitoring, capacity management, local regulatory accountability and decision-making.

Working closely with operational teams and stakeholders, the role identifies opportunities to automate repetitive processes, improve data quality, strengthen controls and enhance reporting efficiency. It supports the production of regulatory information required by the CSSF, the Luxembourg tax authorities (AED) and, increasingly, AMLA, with AMLA-related requests already being received and processed by the function.
A significant portion of the information used by the role relates to highly confidential client, investor and beneficial ownership data. The role therefore requires direct Luxembourg access to the full data population, including clients and investors who have refused outsourcing arrangements or whose contractual confidentiality undertakings restrict data transfers outside Luxembourg, in addition to Luxembourg professional secrecy and GDPR requirements.

The role sits at the intersection of AML/KYC operations, governance, data analytics, AI and automation, ensuring that transformation initiatives remain aligned with Luxembourg regulatory requirements, client expectations and operational realities. Its primary purpose is oversight, data consolidation, quality challenge, management intelligence, regulatory reporting support and automation, rather than operational processing.

The role suits someone analytical and process-driven, who can turn complex data into clear business recommendations and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities (how we will measure success)

• Timely and accurate delivery of management reporting, dashboards and KPI packs to agreed deadlines;
• Reporting outputs that stakeholders actively use to monitor performance, capacity and workload;
• Measurable efficiency gains from automating manual and repetitive reporting processes;
• Improved data quality and stronger reporting controls, with issues identified and resolved at source;
• Solving problems by providing innovative ideas in improving/developing internal systems to meet set objectives & maximise the team efficiency;
• Clear, actionable insights and recommendations that support planning and management decision-making.
• Effective consolidated Luxembourg-wide oversight of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks, including the full client and investor population relevant to local regulatory accountability;
• Reliable management information, data analytics and regulatory reporting support for Luxembourg management, RCs and Conducting Officers;

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis)

• Designing & implementing automated reporting processes and KPIs, using Excel (including VBA), Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform;
• Building and maintaining dashboards, management reporting packs, forecasts and capacity models for operational teams and senior management;
• Ability to create reports/presentations (data visualisation) to be delivered to internal stakeholders as well as to clients;
• Handling data management of the team and leading projects on data cleansing, data quality and reconciliation;
• Translating business requirements into scalable solutions across Excel, SharePoint, Power Platform and other business applications;
• Identifying and delivering process improvement and automation opportunities, including support for AI and automation initiatives;
• Analysing performance, capacity and workload trends, and turning the findings into clear recommendations for management;
• Documenting reporting processes, data sources and controls so that outputs are accurate, repeatable and auditable;
• Maintaining a consolidated Luxembourg-wide view of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks across the client, investor and beneficial ownership population and supporting the production of CSSF, AED and AMLA-related regulatory information;
• Providing Luxembourg management with a 360-degree view of relevant AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks through consolidated reporting, data analytics, quality challenge and management information;
• Challenging data gaps, inconsistencies and reporting issues at source, including through direct interaction with Luxembourg teams, clients, auditors, RCs, Conducting Officers and senior management;
• Ensuring that AI, automation and data transformation initiatives remain embedded within the business, close to Luxembourg decision-makers and aligned with regulatory requirements, client expectations and operational realities;
• Representing IQ-EQ Luxembourg and the AML/KYC function at AI-focused forums, industry roundtables and strategic discussions with key partners , including EY, PwC, law firms and other market stakeholders, to strengthen market presence, foster innovation, share industry insights and identify emerging opportunities;
• You will be required to respond to queries from our stakeholders (clients, colleagues, management), whether by telephone or in writing, in a timely and courteous manner;

Key competencies for position and level (see Group Competency model)

• Advanced Excel, including VBA
• Microsoft Power BI
• Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and SharePoint
• Data analysis and business insight
• Proficient use of AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude AI to support analysis, automation, drafting and productivity improvements
• Process improvement and automation mindset
• Understanding of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS regulatory reporting, Luxembourg professional secrecy, data confidentiality and outsourcing considerations;
• Action oriented
• Critical thinker
• Collaborates
• Drives result (time management, prioritise tasks & consistent in meeting deadlines)

Key behaviours we expect to see

In addition to demonstrating our Group Values (Authentic, Bold, and Collaborative), the role holder will be expected to demonstrate the following:

• Have excellent communications skills, verbal and written, including the ability to explain data and technical concepts to a non-technical audience;
• Attention to detail and good organisational skills;
• Have the ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities and develop the right attitude;
• Curiosity about new tools and ways of working, including automation and AI.
• Ability to operate with sound judgement when handling highly confidential information and when balancing regulatory, client, operational and transformation priorities;

Requirements

• Degree Holder in /Finance/Data Analytics/Business Administration or a related discipline,
• Minimum 3/4 years relevant working experience in management reporting, data analytics or business intelligence (preferably in financial services or fund administration);
• Demonstrable experience in dashboard development, reporting automation, process improvement and operational transformation;
• Strong IT skills (advanced Excel and VBA, Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, SharePoint and any other relevant qualification/knowledge);
• Experience with SQL or other data query tools would be considered as an advantage;
• Fluent in English, and French would be considered as an advantage.

title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
description:
Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

title: Clinical Research Associate (m/f)
description:
The Clinical Research Associate works at LIH's Clinical and Epidemiological Investigation Center.

She/He will:

• Coordinate clinical research projects according to the protocol, budget and fixed timelines.
• Supervise and assist regulatory submissions to health authorities including the national research ethics committee.
• Support private sponsors, researchers and investigators from other research institutions or hospitals in the set up
and conduct of clinical research projects.
• Ensure compliance with the applicable legal, administrative and regulatory requirements.
• Provide specific expertise and know-how in clinical research.
• Provide support to safety reporting and adverse events reporting.
• Monitor clinical trials and guarantee the quality of the scientific data collected during the study.

Key Accountabilities

Site coordination & monitoring accountabilities:

• Be the interface between the various partners involved in clinical research projects including clinicians and researchers.
• Conduct the regulatory submissions according to the applicable laws and obtain approvals.
• Set-up financial contracts and manage financial aspects during the projects.
• Monitor and coordinate clinical research activities at different sites both at a national and international level including study design activities, initiation with all involved partners, monitoring, safety reporting and data management.
• Collect data, report it in the CRF and check that the data entered is consistent with the medical record of each patient.
• Participate in the quality procedure (evaluation process, drafting procedures, etc.), implementation of SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and their validation process.
• Participate in European consortia and grant applications.
• Ensure on-site monitoring of clinical research projects at different sites, both nationally and internationally.

Data Management accountabilities:

• Contribute to the design, development, and review of eCRF forms, ensuring that fields, workflows, and edit checks are aligned with the study protocol and operational feasibility.
• Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of the electronic data capture (EDC) system by testing the eCRF, workflows, queries, and system functionalities before database go-live.
• Perform data review and data cleaning activities, including identifying data discrepancies, reviewing system-generated queries, and resolving issues in collaboration with investigators and Data Managers.
• Support database lock.

Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications

• Master's degree in the field of Medical/Health, Biomedical, or Life Sciences or Biology/Biotechnology related sciences.
• Certified clinical research training (DIU-FARC, DIU-TEC, etc.).
• At least 2 years of experience in the domain of clinical research (CRO, clinical trial unit or research centre, pharmaceutical industry) including a significant on-site monitoring experience.
• Experience in multi-center international clinical trials.
• Good understanding of EU and Luxembourg research regulation frameworks, including patient rights, data protection (GDPR), Clinical Trial Regulation (CTR), and procedures of the CA and EC.
• Familiarity with EU and international regulatory frameworks for clinical research, data protection, and the secondary use of data and samples (e.g. CTR, GDPR, ICH-GCP, MDR).
• Ability to interact positively with advisors and regulatory authorities.
• Independent and multidisciplinary team working abilities, meticulous, motivated, creative and scientifically innovative.
• Strong oral and written communication skills, be able of summarising ideas and prioritising.
• Language skills: Fluent in French and English. Any other commonly spoken language in Luxembourg such as Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish would be an added advantage.

Located in Luxembourg, LIH offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international and multilingual environment that values personal respect and professional achievement based on the highest intellectual and ethical standards. The remuneration for this position shall be based on qualification and experience.

Applications including a cover letter and a curriculum vitae should be sent before April 30, 2026 via our website

title: Head of Internal Audit (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
C-27001 HEAD OF INTERNAL AUDIT
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

Context

As the Head of Internal Audit, you will lead, structure and continuously develop LIST's Internal Audit Service, an independent and objective assurance and advisory function serving the Board of Directors through the Finance and Audit Committee.
The role provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control, while supporting compliance with applicable laws and regulations and contributing to the continuous improvement of LIST's organisation and operations.

In addition to defining the internal audit strategy and the risk-based annual audit plan, you will oversee the full audit lifecycle, from planning and execution to reporting, follow-up and quality assurance. The role also leads specific assurance, advisory and investigation assignments and ensures that Internal Audit methodologies, policies, processes and the Internal Audit Charter remain robust and aligned with professional internal audit standards.

Working closely with the Board of Directors, the Finance and Audit Committee, the CEO, Executive Management, Risk Management, external auditors and auditees, you will provide clear insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making while safeguarding the independence, objectivity and credibility of the function.

Your team and environment

Your team - 3 people

• Head of Internal Audit - 1 | leadership of the function, audit strategy, governance and stakeholder engagement
• Internal Audit collaborators - 2 | contribution to assurance, advisory, audit follow-up and continuous improvement activities

The Internal Audit Service operates as an independent function within LIST and coordinates with Risk Management, where relevant, to leverage synergies and avoid duplication of work without prejudice to its independence.
You will report to the Chair of the Board of Directors, or to the Vice-Chair in the event of replacement of the Chair, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter. For administrative and day-to-day matters, you will report to the CEO.

Description

You will be mainly responsible for:

Internal Audit Leadership & Governance

• Lead and develop the Internal Audit Service, setting a high standard for performance, integrity, objectivity, confidentiality and competence

Job Description

The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Reporting to the Head of Transportation, this role bridges strategic regional transport objectives with daily execution—overseeing both direct customer deliveries and internal site movements.
The position combines technical system ownership (TRAX TMS & QAD ERP), master data governance, order/lead-time investigations, carrier integration management, and operational standardization across all regional manufacturing plants and distribution centers.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.
• Routing & Execution Logic: Maintain and optimize TRAX routing rules, logic parameters, and ship-via assignment rules per ship-to destination.
• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.
• Documentation & Carrier EDI: Setup specific delivery instructions per ship-to to ensure dynamic printing on Weight-Lists and seamless EDI transmission to carriers; configure specialized invoicing setups (e.g., single weight-list per order rule).
• Network Availability & Calendars: Update and govern site and customer holiday closures to prevent system tendering errors and inaccurate delivery commitments.

2. ERP Integration & Analytical Investigations

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Experience (CSR), Manufacturing Operations, Warehouse Logistics, and Carriers.
Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Systems Engineering.
• Experience: 5+ years of operational transportation management or logistics systems experience within a complex, multi-site European/EMENA environment.
• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

Additional Information

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Compensation & Benefits: Benefit from a labor agreement with salary increases, a qualified social minimum wage, and automatic salary indexation to inflation. Enjoy a seniority incentive, profit sharing, and a 13th-month salary (with the option to convert it into additional leave).

• Flexibility & On-site Perks: Embrace flexible work arrangements for white-collar roles. Enjoy a subsidized canteen, an annual gift for employees and children, and a mobile app that centralizes services, benefits, vouchers, and discounts.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. • Extracting, isolating and purifying galactomannans from forage legume seeds

• Promoting and disseminating your research work through high-quality scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals, oral and poster presentations in conferences, and patents.

title: Risk Manager EMEA - P&C (m/f)
description:
We are offering a unique opportunity to join the P&C Re EMEA Risk Management team, reporting to the Chief Risk Officer of Swiss Re Europe and Head of P&C EMEA Risk Management in Luxembourg and work closely with the CRO of SRE UK Branch. In this role, you will contribute to the risk oversight of EMEA P&C Market Units, working on a broad range of underwriting and business risks.

As Risk Manager EMEA, you will gain broad exposure to Swiss Re's global risk landscape, with a focus on P&C Re underwriting across EMEA. You'll ensure that risks arising from strategic, operational, and market developments are proactively identified and addressed. This role is part of Swiss Re's NEXT journey, offering access to high-impact initiatives, senior stakeholders, and opportunities to shape the future of risk management. Your P&C reinsurance expertise, strong communication skills, and adaptive mindset will allow you to influence key decisions and drive meaningful change.

Key responsibilities

Strategic & Portfolio Oversight

•    Evaluate the P&C Re EMEA underwriting strategy at portfolio level and contribute to the global risk view on business strategy.
•    Review the execution of strategic plans across EMEA, considering regulatory, geopolitical, and market trends.

Transaction & Risk Reviews

•    Assess large and complex P&C transactions in EMEA from both quantitative and qualitative risk angles, influencing decisions at business unit and legal entity levels.
•    Lead or contribute to insurance risk reviews for specific EMEA markets or cross-cutting topics in collaboration with other risk teams.
•    Contribute to the review of material L&H transactions underwritten by Swiss Re Europe and its branches.

Operational risk focus

•    Support identification and mitigation of operational risks related to underwriting activities.

Risk communication

•    Drive impactful internal and external risk communication at Swiss Re Europe and P&C Re Risk Management level.
•    Bring forward new risk insights based on market developments and ongoing interactions with internal partners.

Collaboration is a key to our success.

•    You will work in close co-operation with colleagues across Risk Management to ensure consistency, efficiency and to leverage the full available expertise.
•    You will closely interact with underwriters, client underwriters and develop and maintain trusted relationships with Key Risk Takers in the P&C Re EMEA (e.g. Market Heads).
•    You will contribute to and drive risk management activities, strategic initiatives and projects globally.

About You

We are looking for a motivated professional with a strong risk or underwriting background and the following qualities:

•    Technical background: Experience in underwriting or pricing within P&C (re)insurance.
•    Analytical skills: Ability to simplify complex issues and identify prioritise material risks.
•    Challenge mindset: Comfortable giving constructive feedback and acting as a respected challenger.
•    Emotional intelligence: Strong interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to navigate across styles and geographies.
•    Execution & resilience: Self-starter with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage shifting priorities under pressure.
•    Team orientation: Energized by teamwork, with a focus on outcomes and creating value.
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills, with high attention to detail

For Luxembourg, the base salary range for this position is between 71,000 EUR  and EUR 119,000  for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

•    the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
•    the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience. In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
•    In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

About Risk Management and the Team

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing Risk Management hub in Luxembourg, bringing together colleagues from different risk disciplines across Swiss Re's global footprint — including EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. We are a highly motivated and diverse team that values collaboration, inclusion, and integrity. Our variety of backgrounds and skill sets enables us to provide broad, high-impact support to our stakeholders.We embrace change as an opportunity, enjoy learning from each other, and believe that a good sense of humour and open feedback culture are essential to success.

Looking forward to you application!

You will act as a partner to the Head of Finance and other stakeholders, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting while driving efficiencies and supporting decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Reporting

• Act as the primary back-up to he Head of Finance and step in when required;
• Own the monthly accounting close process, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and timeless of consolidated reporting to group level;
• Prepare and deliver complete year-end financial statements, in compliance with local and IFRS standards (IFRS 16);
• Lead the preparation and review of management reporting, including KPI dashboards and variance analysis;
• Ensure compliance with VAT Filings, Tax returns and manage preparation of audit documentation for external auditors.

Controlling & Analysis

• Drive the budgeting process, coordinate planning inputs, and perform variance analyses with key stakeholders;
• Review financial performance, explain kye trends, and provide insight to support strategic decisions;

Process & Systems Optimization

• Lead the review and optimization of accounting and finance processes (e.g., closing, invoicing, bank, budget tracking);
• Support the digitalization of finance, including tool implementation (e.g., ERP, Manual journal entries automations);
• Contribute to the strengthening internal controls and compliance procedures.

Team Coordination & Cross-Functional Support

• Collaborate closely with accounting, tax, Business and operations teams;
• Supervise junior team members when applicable and support professional development;

Profile

• Master's degree (BAC+5) in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field;
• Minimum 5 years experience in a similar role, ideally in a multinational or fast-paced environment;
• Solid Knowledge of Luxembourg GAP, Luxembourg corporate taxation, and VAT Rules;
• Proficiency in IFRS and experience with Management reporting processes;
• High attention to detail, strong analytical and organizational skills;
• Autonomous, results-driven, and able to meet tight deadlines under pressure;
• Strong communication skills, team spirit, and flexibility;
• Solid command of Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel); familiarity with WorkDay, Alterix is a plus;
• Fluent in French; proficiency in English is highly desirable.

What we look for

• A builder mindset - you look for ways to improve and scale processes.
• Someone who can dive deep into financial data and extract meaningful insights.
• A strong sense of ownership and urgency when delivering results.
• A collaborative leader who uplifts others and acts as a trusted business partner.

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Associate – Infrastructure & Private Markets Valuation & Modelling (m/f/d). What if it was you?  

Your mission: A career in our Valuation & Modelling Services practice will provide you with the opportunity to work at the forefront of valuation, financial modelling, and investment analysis across private markets.

As part of the largest and most qualified dedicated valuation and modelling team in Luxembourg, you will advise leading alternative investment managers, institutional investors, infrastructure funds, private equity sponsors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and multinational corporations on complex valuation and modelling matters throughout the investment lifecycle.

Recognised as a centre of excellence for portfolio valuation, our team delivers independent valuations and reviews of investment portfolios, businesses, complex securities, financial instruments, and intangible assets for financial and investor reporting, regulatory compliance, governance, and strategic decision-making.

Our team also works closely with PwC Luxembourg's market-leading Assurance practice, supporting a broad range of valuation matters across audit engagements. This provides our professionals with unique exposure to valuation challenges across multiple asset classes, investment structures, and industries, while helping maintain the highest standards of quality, consistency, and professional rigour.

Our professionals come from diverse backgrounds, including leading asset managers, infrastructure investors, private equity firms, valuation boutiques, advisory practices, and audit firms. Together, we combine deep technical expertise with practical investment experience to help clients navigate increasingly sophisticated valuation challenges across infrastructure, private equity, venture capital, private debt, real estate, and other alternative asset classes.

Our multidisciplinary experience allows us to engage confidently with investment professionals, valuation committees, risk teams, boards of directors, external auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders to deliver robust, independent, and insightful analyses that support informed decision-making.


Be a part of our team where you will:

Carry out various assignments for valuation and modelling across different industries and situations, including portfolio valuations, business valuations, intangible valuations, complex securities valuation, and ad hoc modelling engagements;  
Prepare detailed financial modelling, business plans, financial analysis and the application of a variety of valuation methodologies;  
Assess reasonableness of valuations and financial models prepared by others;  
Assist clients with their understanding of complex financial structures;  
Apply generally accepted valuation principles, methodologies, and techniques in support of IPEV, IFRS, US GAAP and Lux GAAP;  
Perform valuation analyses of financial instruments, structured products, and complex capital structures;
Develop independent financial models using income, market, and option-based approaches;
Analyse complex situations and formulate practical, value-added recommendations;  
Leverage multiple data sources and stakeholder perspectives to develop robust conclusions;  
Use data and insights to support investment, governance, and reporting decisions;  
Develop a point of view on key market developments and emerging valuation trends;  
Manage multiple stakeholder perspectives and build consensus around complex issues;  
Communicate technical concepts in a clear and concise manner;  
Produce outstanding deliverables for clients across the private markets ecosystem;  
Continuously develop new skills and deepen your valuation, modelling, and investment expertise.


Let's talk about you. If you...

Hold a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field;
Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, with excellent command of English — German and French are strong assets, and any other European language is considered valuable;
Have 2–5 years of professional experience in Valuation and Modelling, ideally gained within the valuation or modelling advisory team of a Big Four firm, a professional services firm (e.g., Mazars, BDO, Grant Thornton), or a specialist advisory firm (e.g., BHB Partners, Stout, VRC, Houlihan Lokey, Alvarez & Marsal, Accuracy, Eight Advisory);
Have exposure to private capital alternative investments (e.g., private equity, infrastructure, venture capital, private debt);
Experience in infrastructure and project finance valuation, financial modelling, transaction analysis, or investment appraisal would be highly valued;
Demonstrate strong financial modelling skills in Microsoft Excel — capable of building three-way models and adhering to best practices (e.g., avoiding hard-coded figures and inefficient formulas such as VLOOKUP, INDIRECT, or nested IFs);
Possess solid knowledge of financial statement analysis under IFRS, US GAAP, and/or Lux GAAP;
Have experience with option pricing models (e.g., Black-Scholes, Binomial Trees, Monte Carlo) and/or Purchase Price Allocations (considered valuable);
Can create high-quality deliverables using Microsoft PowerPoint;
Are progressing toward a professional finance or accounting qualification (e.g., CFA, CAIA, CPV, CVA, ASA, CBV, ACCA, ACA, CPA, CA, AFM, CFM, FMVA, FRM, CQF);
Are highly organized, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously;
Demonstrate a strong team attitude, a willingness to support others, share expertise, and contribute positively to a collaborative, high-performing culture;
Demonstrate strong attention to detail and a healthy level of professional skepticism;
Are proactive, intellectually curious, and committed to continuous learning;
Bring positive energy, humility, and a good sense of humor to the team.

Job Description & Summary

Lernen Sie Ihr zukünftiges Team kennen

Sie werden Teil des Risk-Assurance-Teams bei PwC Luxemburg und arbeiten eng mit AML/CFT-Spezialist:innen aus den Bereichen Assurance und Advisory zusammen. Das Team unterstützt Banken, Versicherungen, Asset Manager, Investment Fonds und Finanzdienstleister durch kollaborative, multidisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit.

So sieht Ihre Rolle aus

Diese Position ist auf Manager- bis Senior-Manager-Ebene angesiedelt und spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Leitung und Durchführung von AML/CFT-Mandaten mit hoher regulatorischer und operativer Relevanz. Sie verbinden Fachwissen, Kundeninteraktion und Teamführung, um AML/CFT-Strukturen nachhaltig zu stärken.

• Leitung und Steuerung von AML/CFT-Mandaten von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung unter Sicherstellung hoher Qualitätsstandards

• Zentrale Ansprechperson für Kund:innen mit Fokus auf pragmatische Umsetzung regulatorischer Anforderungen
• Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Teammitgliedern durch fachliche Anleitung und Feedback
• Mitwirkung an komplexen Untersuchungen oder Remediation-Projekten, bei denen Struktur und Urteilsvermögen entscheidend sind
Ihre Entwicklung und Möglichkeiten

Mit zunehmender Erfahrung erweitern Sie Ihren Verantwortungsbereich in komplexen Mandaten, Kundenbeziehungen und Teamführung. Die Rolle bietet Raum zur fachlichen Vertiefung und zur aktiven Mitgestaltung der AML/CFT-Services.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Masterabschluss oder gleichwertiger Abschluss in Recht, Wirtschaft, Audit oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Relevante Berufserfahrung im AML/CFT-Umfeld in Finanzinstituten, Compliance-Funktionen oder Professional Services
• Fundierte Kenntnisse der luxemburgischen und/oder internationalen AML/CFT-Regulierung und Geschäftsprozesse
• Gute Einarbeitung in das EU AML Rahmenwerk, das ab 2027 europaweit gilt
• Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Word und Excel
• Englisch (C1) und Französisch (C2), oder Englisch (C1) und Deutsch (C2)

Arbeitsweise

• Komplexe Informationen analysieren, strukturieren und fundierte Entscheidungen treffen
• Effizientes und strukturierte Vorgehensweise
• Effektiv mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um gemeinsame Ergebnisse zu erzielen
• Vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen durch Verständnis für deren Kontext und Mehrwertorientierung
• Sie handeln integer, gehen sorgfältig mit vertraulichen Informationen um und wahren jederzeit hohe ethische Standards
• Sie sind in der Lage komplexe Sachverhalte, strukturiert und verständlich zu erklären

Zusätzliche Fähigkeiten, die Ihren Erfolg unterstützen

Die aufgeführten Fähigkeiten zeigen, worauf es in dieser Rolle besonders ankommt. Wenn Ihre Erfahrung dazu passt – auch wenn Ihr Weg anders aussieht – freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung und darauf, mit Ihnen ins Gespräch zu kommen.
Machen Sie den nächsten Schritt

Übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für wirkungsvolle AML/CFT-Mandate in einem dynamischen regulatorischen Umfeld. Entwickeln Sie Ihre Expertise weiter, gestalten Sie Kundenergebnisse aktiv mit und schaffen Sie Vertrauen. Grow here. Go further.

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.

Ansøg allerede i dag.
Mathias@jobsqd.com

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
description:
Als deutschsprachiger Kundenbetreuer (Customer Account Advisor) bist du Teil eines europäischen Kundenserviceteams und unterstützt internationale Kundinnen und Kunden direkt von unserem Büro im sonnigen Malta aus.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: After-Sales Engineer / Technical Customer Support – Battery Energy Storage Systems (m/f/d) (Kundendienstmonteur/in, -techniker/in)
description:
Über uns

Die RCT Energy Technology GmbH mit Sitz in Konstanz ist ein technologieorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich Energiespeichersysteme und intelligenter Energielösungen.

Unser Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst Energiespeichersysteme, Wechselrichter, Batterielösungen und Energiemanagementsysteme für private, gewerbliche, industrielle und großtechnische Anwendungen. Dabei stehen technische Innovation, Produktqualität, zuverlässige Projektabwicklung und die Anforderungen unserer Kunden im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen After-Sales Engineer (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme mit Arbeitsort in den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines hochwertigen technischen Supports und Projektmanagements für unsere CESS-Systeme und gewerblichen Speicherlösungen.
• Planung und Koordination von Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeeinsätzen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.
• Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service-Level-Agreements (SLA) sowie Wartungsvereinbarungen.
• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort einschließlich der Organisation der erforderlichen Ersatzteilversorgung.
• Technische Unterstützung von Installationspartnern während der Inbetriebnahme von Systemen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort.
• Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines projektbezogenen Berichtssystems zur Nachverfolgung und Optimierung der Supportprozesse.
• Bearbeitung technischer Anfragen über das zentrale Servicepostfach sowie systematische Erfassung und Nachverfolgung der Vorgänge im Ticketsystem.
• Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Rückgabe- und Reklamationsverfahren (RMA) für CESS- und RESS-Systeme.

Ihr Profil

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport oder im Servicebereich von Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.
• Qualifikationen wie VCA, NEN 3140 VP und NEN 1010 sind von Vorteil.
• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise.
• Teamfähigkeit, Organisationstalent und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
• Arbeits- beziehungsweise Wohnort in den Niederlanden sowie die Bereitschaft, unsere Geschäftstätigkeiten innerhalb der Europäischen Union per Remote-Support oder vor Ort zu unterstützen.
• Sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen.
• Gültiger Führerschein und praktische Fahrerfahrung; ein eigenes Fahrzeug ist von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

• Eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen der erneuerbaren Energien.
• Die Möglichkeit, innovative großtechnische Batteriespeicherlösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und einen Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft zu leisten.
• Ein teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
• Attraktive Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle.
• Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
• Moderne Arbeitsplätze und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.
• JobRad und JobTicket.

Ondernemers zoeken geen advocaat die jurisprudentie uit zijn mouw schudt of indrukwekkende adviezen schrijft waar niemand verder mee komt. Zij zoeken iemand die begrijpt wat er in hun bedrijf speelt, helder communiceert en het probleem daadwerkelijk oplost. Iemand die eerlijk zegt wanneer procederen verstandig is, maar ook wanneer dat niet is.
Dat is precies hoe wij werken.
Bij De Neef Advocaten geloven wij dat een Advocaat uiteindelijk wordt beoordeeld op het resultaat dat hij voor zijn cliënt bereikt. Daarom zoeken wij geen ghostwriter of urenmachine. Sie entwickeln Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Preis- und Sortimentsstrategien und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum eines zukunftsorientierten Geschäftsfeldes. Dabei agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Herstellern und internen Fachbereichen.

- Verhandlungen:  Sie führen Jahresgespräche sowie Preis-, Konditions- und Vertragsverhandlungen und erzielen nachhaltige Ergebnisse für unser Geschäft

- Geschäftsentwicklung:  Sie begleiten den Ausbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung strategischer Beschaffungs- und Vermarktungskonzepte mit, dabei bringen Sie ihre Ideen proaktiv ein
- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Durch Ihre Persönlichkeit schaffen Sie es sich ein Netzwerk in der Pharmabranche aufzubauen
- Innovation:  Sie treiben Zukunftsthemen wie den Ausbau von Direktbezugsmodellen und die Entwicklung neuer Lieferantenstrategien im Apothekenumfeld voran

- Berufserfahrung:  Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf, Category Management oder im Lieferantenmanagement mit und haben bereits Verantwortung für Sortimente, Umsatz- oder Geschäftsentwicklung übernommen
- Branchenverständnis:   Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrungen im Pharma-, Healthcare-, Apotheken-, Handels- oder FMCG-Umfeld
- Verhandlungsgeschick:  Sie überzeugen durch eine hohe Abschlussstärke und haben Erfahrung in der Führung anspruchsvoller Lieferanten- und Vertragsverhandlungen
- Analysekompetenz:   Auf Basis von Kennzahlen, Marktanalysen und wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen treffen Sie Entscheidungen
- Unternehmerisches Denken und Innovationsgeist:   Sie verfügen über die Fähigkeit, Chancen in dynamischen Märkten zu identifizieren, innovative Konzepte zu entwickeln und diese erfolgreich in nachhaltige Geschäftserfolge zu überführen
- Reisebereitschaft:  Den persönlichen Austausch mit Geschäftspartnern schätzen Sie und bringen die Bereitschaft für Dienstreisen mit

description:
Mit der Rossmann-Apotheke B.V. bauen wir ein neues Angebot im digitalen Gesundheitsmarkt auf: Eine vollwertige Apotheke, die einen einfachen, verantwortungsvollen und kundenorientierten Zugang zu Arzneimitteln und apothekennaher Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen wird. Dabei agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Herstellern und internen Fachbereichen.

- Geschäftsentwicklung:  Sie begleiten den Ausbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung strategischer Beschaffungs- und Vermarktungskonzepte mit, dabei bringen Sie ihre Ideen proaktiv ein
- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. - Analysekompetenz:   Auf Basis von Kennzahlen, Marktanalysen und wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen treffen Sie Entscheidungen
- Unternehmerisches Denken und Innovationsgeist:   Sie verfügen über die Fähigkeit, Chancen in dynamischen Märkten zu identifizieren, innovative Konzepte zu entwickeln und diese erfolgreich in nachhaltige Geschäftserfolge zu überführen
- Reisebereitschaft:  Den persönlichen Austausch mit Geschäftspartnern schätzen Sie und bringen die Bereitschaft für Dienstreisen mit

title: INDEPENDENT WORKING CHEF 1
description:
Job Description

As an Independent Working Chef, you will be responsible for independently preparing dishes according to our menu and quality standards. You will also support and guide the kitchen team during busy periods.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Independently preparing dishes according to the restaurant’s menu and quality standards.

* Preparing, processing and portioning ingredients independently.

* Applying basic cooking techniques used in Chinese cuisine.

* Ensuring compliance with hygiene and food safety requirements in accordance with HACCP guidelines.

* Working closely with the kitchen team and supporting colleagues during busy periods.

* Checking stock levels and managing orders.

* Maintaining effective inventory and purchasing management.

* Providing technical guidance and supervision to kitchen assistants.

* Directing and adjusting the work of kitchen assistants when necessary.

* Contributing ideas regarding the composition and possible changes to the menu, dishes and preparation methods.

* Monitoring the quality, taste and presentation of dishes.

* Taking responsibility for the organization and efficient operation of the assigned kitchen activities.

Requirements

We are looking for a motivated and independent chef who:

* Can work independently and also function effectively as part of a team.

* Is passionate, creative and has an eye for detail.

* Is flexible and able to work effectively under pressure, including during busy periods.

* Has a good understanding of hygiene regulations and food safety.

* Has an MBO level 3 working and thinking level, or an equivalent level of knowledge and experience.

* Has demonstrable knowledge of basic cooking techniques used in Chinese cuisine.

* Is willing to take responsibility for their own duties and contribute to the organization of the kitchen.

* Has relevant practical experience in Chinese cuisine.

title: Industriële Schilders
description:
Het uitvoeren van industriële schilder‑ en oppervlaktebehandelingswerkzaamheden met als doel het duurzaam beschermen van industriële installaties, staalconstructies, machines, leidingen en opslagtanks tegen corrosie, chemicaliën, slijtage en overige invloeden. Dit gebeurt volgens geldende veiligheidsnormen, kwaliteitsrichtlijnen en projectspecificaties.

Verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Voorbereiden van oppervlakken door reinigen, ontvetten, schuren (manueel of machinaal) en stralen.
  • Aanbrengen van primers, laklagen, epoxy‑coatings, polyurethaan‑coatings en andere beschermsystemen.
  • Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles zoals droge en natte laagdiktemetingen, visuele inspecties en hechtingscontroles, temperatuur- en luchtvochtigheidsmetingen en ruwheidsmetingen.
  • Correct instellen en bedienen van schilder-, straal‑ en spuitapparatuur.
  • Afdekken en beschermen van niet‑te‑behandelen zones.
  • Signaleren van afwijkingen, beschadigingen of corrosieproblemen en uitvoeren van herstelwerkzaamheden.
  • Registreren van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en gebruikte materialen.
  • Werken volgens veiligheidsinstructies (VCA), inclusief correcte inzet van PBM’s.
  • Eventueel ondersteunen bij brandwerende, chemisch resistente of hygiënische coatings.
  • In teamverband samenwerken met (meewerkende) voormannen en inspecteurs.

Je hebt geen hoogtevrees en je bent een echte teamplayer. Je bent bereid om nieuwe zaken te leren zodat je op rustigere momenten multidisciplinair inzetbaar bent.

title: Graafmaschinist (m/v/x) (Tiefbaufacharbeiter/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
description:
Graafmachinist 16 ton (m/v/x)

AA Schroefpalen B.V. | Malden (Gelderland) | Fulltime | Per direct

Het belangrijkste op een rij

- Werkgebied: projectlocaties door heel Nederland
- Fulltime dienstverband
- Uitzicht op een vast contract
- Salaris boven de cao Bouw & Infra
- 45 vrije dagen per jaar
- Moderne machines en materieel
- Opleidingen en certificaten kunnen via AA Schroefpalen worden behaald

Over AA Schroefpalen

AA Schroefpalen is gespecialiseerd in trillingsvrije funderingsoplossingen. Vanuit onze vestiging in Malden realiseren wij funderingsprojecten door heel Nederland.

Met moderne funderingsmachines, graafmachines en digitaal boormanagement zorgen wij voor een veilige, efficiënte en nauwkeurige uitvoering van onze projecten.

AA Schroefpalen is onderdeel van de Possehl Group en werkt nauw samen met de Duitse zusteronderneming JACBO Pfahlgründungen GmbH.

Bij ons vind je korte lijnen, een nuchtere werksfeer en collega’s die zeggen wat ze doen en doen wat ze zeggen.

Ben jij thuis op een 16-tons graafmachine?

Voor onze funderingsprojecten zoeken wij een ervaren graafmachinist voor een circa 16-tons rupsgraafmachine.

Je werkt direct samen met de boormachinist, funderingswerkers en uitvoerder en zorgt ervoor dat de bouwplaats rondom de funderingswerkzaamheden goed voorbereid, veilig en efficiënt blijft.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met grondverzet, het voorbereiden en onderhouden van de werkplek, het verplaatsen van materiaal en het ondersteunen van de funderingsploeg.

Je weet wat een machine kan, werkt gecontroleerd en houdt voortdurend rekening met collega’s, andere machines en werkzaamheden in jouw omgeving.

Jouw werkzaamheden

- Veilig en zelfstandig bedienen van een circa 16-tons rupsgraafmachine;
- Uitvoeren van grondverzet op funderingsprojecten;
- Egaliseren en voorbereiden van werkterreinen;
- Vrijmaken en toegankelijk houden van de werkplek rondom de funderingsmachine;
- Verplaatsen van grond en bouwmaterialen;
- Ondersteunen van de funderingsploeg tijdens de uitvoering;
- Voorbereiden van locaties voor het aanbrengen van funderingspalen;
- Werken volgens tekeningen, maatvoering en aanwijzingen van de uitvoerder;
- Veilig werken rondom funderingsmachines, vrachtwagens en ander zwaar materieel;
- Uitvoeren van de dagelijkse machinecontrole en LMRA;
- Controleren van hydrauliek, rupsen, bakken, snelwissel en andere aanbouwdelen;
- Signaleren van slijtage, schade en storingen;
- Uitvoeren van dagelijks onderhoud en kleine werkzaamheden aan de machine;
- Zorgdragen voor een veilige, nette en goed georganiseerde werkplek.

Waar jij blij van wordt

- Een passend salaris (cao Bouw & Infra), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;
- Een contract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
- 45 vrije dagen per jaar;
- Uitbetaling van overuren of compensatie in vrije tijd;
- Vergoeding van reisuren en toepasselijke toeslagen volgens de geldende bedrijfsregeling;
- Een moderne graafmachine en goed onderhouden materieel;
- Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid;
- Afwisselende funderingsprojecten door heel Nederland;
- Een klein en betrokken team;
- Korte communicatielijnen;
- Een collegiale en nuchtere werksfeer;
- Cursussen, opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden;
- Mogelijkheid om benodigde certificaten via AA Schroefpalen te behalen;
- Werkkleding, veiligheidsschoenen en persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen van de zaak.

Waar wij blij van worden

- Ervaring als graafmachinist, bij voorkeur op rupsgraafmachines in de klasse van circa 14–18 ton;
- Ervaring in de bouw, infra, grondverzet of funderingstechniek is een pré;
- Je hebt gevoel voor machines en werkt nauwkeurig;
- Technisch inzicht en basiskennis van mechaniek en hydrauliek;
- Een geldig VCA-certificaat en TCVT certificaat of de bereidheid om dit via ons te behalen;
- Rijbewijs B; rijbewijs BE, C of CE is een pré;
- Je kunt tekeningen, maatvoering en werkinstructies begrijpen;
- Je werkt veilig en houdt rekening met mensen en materieel om je heen;
- Je bent zelfstandig, verantwoordelijk en praktisch ingesteld;
- Je kunt goed samenwerken met boormachinisten, funderingswerkers en uitvoerders;
- Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal voldoende om veilig te kunnen werken en instructies te begrijpen;
- Je bent flexibel inzetbaar op projecten door heel Nederland;
- Incidenteel overnachten voor een project is voor jou bespreekbaar.

Vakmanschap, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en motivatie zijn voor ons belangrijker dan een perfect passend cv.

Kennismaken?

Reageren op deze vacature is eenvoudig. Stuur je cv of een korte beschrijving van je werkervaring naar:

Jana Schäfer
HR-adviseur voor AA Schroefpalen en JACBO Pfahlgründungen

Wij behandelen jouw sollicitatie uiteraard vertrouwelijk.

You love technology, processes and quality. You work accurately, take responsibility and enjoy achieving results together.

Our client is a global leader in medicines, dedicated to creating a healthy world. Through their vaccines, biologics, and medicines, they provide innovative treatments to improve the health of people and animals in more than 140 countries. They focus on conditions that severely impair daily functioning or are life-threatening, and for which new medicines are needed. Our client is also a pioneer in biologics research and development for animal health.

At our client, they believe in the power of diversity within teams of talented employees at all levels. Diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and cultural perspectives help them better understand the needs of their diverse customers, healthcare providers, and patients. Our client employs approximately 4,500 people across three locations in the Netherlands.

description:

Sorting received materials and checking them for accuracy, quality, and requested quantities.

Hier wordt de gezamenlijke koers afgestemd die bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van de organisaties gericht op de dienstverlening aan onze inwoners, ondernemers en maatschappelijke partners. Jij?
Bent per direct beschikbaar en in het bezit van minimaal een afgeronde mbo-opleiding. Je hebt het overzicht bij de receptie. Samen met de andere 'Supersterren' en 'Team Supporters' zorg je ervoor dat onze 'Trotse Talenten' ( stagiaires en oproepkrachten) tot bloei komen. Je verrast onze kampeerders met jouw gastvrijheid en weet met jouw kennis van de Duitse taal ook onze Duitse gasten te charmeren. Jij hebt alles op de rit! De ontvangstruimte bij de receptie en jouw administratie zijn even schoon en verzorgd. Dat is doen wat je belooft!
Flexibele werktijden ? No problemo! Jaarrond werk je 32 uur, tijdens het seizoen 5 dagen per week, en buiten het seizoen 3 dagen per week. Jij bent handig met computers en systemen en draagt uiteraard bij aan een positief teamgevoel. Samen zorgen we dat jouw talenten naar boven komen en jij kan shinen! ✨
En wij?
Zorgen voor blije collega's met liefde en aandacht. Tijdens het seizoen overtref jij samen met je collega's de verwachtingen van elke gast. Eind oktober sluit de camping, maar het werk stopt niet. Ontwikkel jezelf op persoonlijk of professioneel vlak via de KDC Campus, onze online leeromgeving . Zo deel je tijdens ons geweldige eindfeest de leukste weetjes over bier of wijn, ben je helemaal op de hoogte over AI, ijsbaden en ademsessies.
Niet onbelangrijk… Je ontvangt een salaris volgens de Recreatie-cao (schaal 5).
