Additional info:

We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.

You will work 100% onsite in Gothenburg

title: Product Deployment Engineer - Search/performace to leading search engine
description:
We are looking for a Product Deployment Engineer – Search to join the Google App team. The ideal candidate has experience as a Performance Marketing Specialist and will work closely with the team on search-related products and performance. This is a consultancy assignment starting as soon as possible, with an initial duration of up to 12 months.

As a Product Deployment Engineer, you manage external clients and/or consult internal teams to exercise your comprehensive knowledge of translating commercial business models/needs into technical solutions. You own and manage relationships with technical and non-technical manager+ level internal and external users/clients/partners/stakeholders and deliver excellent customer care to achieve project goals. You manage project outcomes and are a key contributor, creating custom solutions, repeatable solution development, customer requirement gathering and mapping, and solution strategy, scoping, and development. You possess core technical skills and comprehensive knowledge of troubleshooting, systems design, integration, and our technologies and processes, using it to act as an industry specialist in your technical domain.

Responsibilities include:

    Provide feedback on product requirement documents (PRDs) and design documents; may author or actively drive PRDs, particularly around the developer experience.
    Review product requirement documents (PRDs) to record product specifications, and validate PRDs to ensure customer/partner and internal needs are met.
    Scale existing or create repeatable solutions (e.g., best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, sample code) and ensure effective documentation of repeatable solutions.
    Drive solution code development in collaboration with internal or external developers/users/partners/clients/stakeholders (as needed). Test products/solutions for customers/partners before release through different phases (e.g., internal testing, user acceptance testing). Contribute to resolving bugs and refining product/solutions through feedback collection and iteration.
    Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders in customer and/or partner organizations to deliver or manage quality technical solutions and services.
    Define long-term technical solution strategies in collaboration with cross-functional teams and influence the direction and priority of technical product features and/or the solution.
    Define and identify problems at the system level or from a broader perspective and design a workable solution. Moderate understanding of how factors or components in a system interrelate. Contribute to defining the appropriate components at scale, application programming interfaces (APIs), and data for a given system to meet specific requirements of the user and the ability to validate the system correctness and functionality.
    Leverage, customize, or develop solutions based on defined customer/partner business objectives and technical requirements. Drive discussions with internal teams and users/clients/partners/stakeholders to define solution constraints and scope. Help identify the value of solutions through design sessions with the customer/partner.
    Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in their respective process lifecycle to provide technical guidance or identify possible existing or new technical solution offerings to help shape outcomes. Contribute to indirectly engaging customers and internal teams as part of the process lifecycle.
    Troubleshoot complex technical issues throughout solution delivery and deployment by generating and analyzing relevant data, proposing fixes, and validating solutions.

Skills Required
As a Product Deployment Engineer (Search), you will serve as a strategic technical authority driving customer adoption, performance, and speed to market for Google’s largest advertisers across diverse industry verticals. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, navigating complex ad tech architectures to design, deploy, and scale advanced Google Search and AI-driven advertising solutions.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and deep technical execution. Working closely with cross-functional sales and product teams, you will deploy cutting-edge Search features—including AI Max for Search, Smart Bidding, advanced data integrations, and feed solutions—ensuring our partners achieve sustainable business growth.

Minimum role qualifications require proficiency in:

    Opportunity and pipeline management
    Industry knowledge
    Situational leadership
    Debugging and troubleshooting
    Stakeholder management strategy
    Systems Thinking (Knowledge)
    Technical acumen
    Core Tech role related knowledge
    System design or Coding
    Team Management
    Consultative skills

title: Destinationschef till First Camp
description:
Vill du leda en destination där gästupplevelser, affärsutveckling och ledarskap går hand i hand? Hos First Camp får du möjlighet att kombinera affärsmässighet, service och ledarskap i en roll med stort ansvar och variation. Här får du driva, utveckla och påverka din destination – med fokus på resultat, gästnöjdhet och teamutveckling – i ett företag som ständigt växer och förändras.

Vilka är First Camp?

Vi är en del av First Camp Group, norra Europas ledande koncern för camping och resorts. Tillsammans är vi på en spännande resa med en tydlig, gemensam vision: att skapa en världsledande campingkedja - där vi är first choice för gäster, medarbetare och campingbranschen i Europa.

Hållbar utveckling och datadrivna gäst- och medarbetarinsikter är viktiga fokusområden för att tillsammans skapa moments of happiness - varje dag.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Destinationschef får du en roll med stort ansvar, variation och verklig påverkan. Du leder helheten på din destination – människor, drift och resultat – och är navet som får allt att fungera tillsammans. Rollen handlar lika mycket om att skapa ordning och struktur som att bygga engagemang, driva affär och utveckla både verksamheten och medarbetarna.

Du är närvarande i vardagen, ser detaljerna som gör skillnad och fattar beslut nära verksamheten. Samtidigt har du blicken framåt och arbetar långsiktigt för att stärka destinationens lönsamhet, gästupplevelse och teamkultur.

I uppdraget ingår bland annat att:

    

Leda, rekrytera och utveckla medarbetare samt säkerställa bemanning, introduktion och en trygg arbetsmiljö.

    

Driva den dagliga driften effektivt och strukturerat, med fokus på kvalitet, service och gästupplevelse.

    

Ansvara för budget, KPI:er och resultat – inklusive försäljning mot både privat- och företagskunder.

    

Arbeta med affärsutveckling, prissättning och paketering i samverkan med supportkontor och kollegor.

    

Vara synlig i verksamheten och coacha teamet i värdskap, bemötande och service – från första intryck till avresa.

    

Samarbeta med Regionchef och centrala funktioner för att säkra samsyn, struktur och resultat.

Rollen kräver närvaro, engagemang och ett tydligt ledarskap – men också nyfikenhet, initiativkraft och viljan att alltid hitta vägar framåt.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker en driven och affärsorienterad ledare med ett genuint intresse för människor och service. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategi och drift, inspirera andra och skapa både resultat och trivsel.

Med tydlighet, engagemang och helhetsperspektiv leder du din destination mot gemensamma mål – och skapar en miljö där både gäster och medarbetare känner sig välkomna, sedda och stolta.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

    

Erfarenhet av ledarskap och personalansvar, gärna från besöksnäring, service, handel eller hotell.

    

God förståelse för ekonomi, affärsutveckling och försäljning.

    

Förmåga att driva förändring, utveckla team och skapa engagemang.

    

Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

    

God systemvana och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat även i ett högt tempo.

    

B-körkort och möjlighet att använda destinationens fordon i arbetet.

    

Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av rekrytering, budgetarbete, B2B-försäljning eller lokalt affärssamarbete.

Som person är du en närvarande och trygg ledare med förmåga att fatta beslut nära verksamheten. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder, skapar tydlighet och energi i teamet och driver förbättringar som gör skillnad för både gäster och medarbetare.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Hos oss får du vara en del av ett ambitiöst företag med både hjärta och framåtanda. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att påverka, utvecklas och växa – samtidigt som du får arbeta nära både människor och verksamhet.

Våra gemensamma värderingar styr våra dagliga handlingar:

We Care – Vi jobbar tillsammans med omtanke om gästen, medarbetaren och planeten. Vi skapar en öppen och stöttande miljö där vi utmanar varandra, lär oss av misstag och firar framgångar.

We Have Fun – Genom att vara oss själva och ha roligt ihop skapar vi en välkomnande stämning för alla vi möter. Tillsammans skapar vi fina minnen för våra team, kollegor och gäster.

We Simplify – Framåtanda, tillsammans med viljan att lära, gör att vi ständigt förbättrar och utvecklar hur vi arbetar. Vi gör det enkelt för varandra – det ska vara lätt att göra rätt för både kollegor och våra gäster.

We Deliver Results – Vi fokuserar i allt vi gör på att skapa resultat för våra gäster, kollegor och hela företaget. Målen är högt satta och vi lyckas bäst när vi använder både hjärta och hjärna.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats med goda möjligheter till utveckling och omtänksamma kollegor som delar med sig av visdom och skratt. Tillsammans vill vi fortsätta vår framgångssaga och växa med fler stjärnor som vill vara med och bygga vår framtid.

Villkor

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och innefattas av kollektivavtal med inledande provanställning. Lön och villkor enligt överenskommelse. Arbetet innefattar visst helg- och kvällsarbete samt delad beredskap.

Ansökan

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan om detta låter som rätt möjlighet för dig.

Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat i våra rekryteringar och fokuserar på att hitta den person som bäst matchar tjänstens kravprofil. För slutkandidater i processen kan utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Som ett första steg i vår urvalsprocess kan du få genomföra rekryteringstester som hjälper oss att säkerställa en rättvis och träffsäker matchning.

title: Account Executive - SMB
description:
About us

Soundtrack is a B2B scale-up company that originated through a partnership with Spotify, previously powering the ‘Spotify Business’ service, and now provides its own music streaming platform for businesses. We serve small customers like the café around the corner, and much bigger brands like IKEA, Barbour, Espresso House and Hard Rock Cafe..

On the inside, we're a team of talented, motivated, and humble individuals, including our dedicated Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams, alongside our expert Designers, Engineers, and Music specialists.

The Role

We’re looking for a self-motivated, collaborative and curious Account Executive to join our Sales team in Stockholm.

You’ll focus on handling inbound leads from small businesses that have 1–5 locations, with the goal of converting them into happy paying customers. You’ll be working with a high volume of around 250 leads per month, using email and short 15-minute calls to close deals through a scalable process.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives on structure, velocity, and the satisfaction of closing many wins, all while delivering a great customer experience.

You’ll report directly to our VP Sales.

Responsibilities

    

Convert leads to customers efficiently at scale

    

Talk to prospects via email or video calls

    

Use automation and AI to enable closing at scale

    

Tailor the pitch to each lead’s use case — from restaurants to bars and retail stores

    

Track your pipeline, forecast monthly MRR, and report on key conversion metrics

    

Work collaboratively with the Sales team to continuously improve the process and playbook; your efforts will shape how we scale SMB sales globally

    

Work independently while staying closely aligned with the wider Sales team

About You

You take ownership, act with purpose, and thrive on making things happen. You're driven by results and consistently aim to exceed expectations. Motivated by impact and revenue, you bring a strong performance mindset to everything you do, all while maintaining a sharp focus on delivering an exceptional customer experience.

You're goal-oriented and proactive, yet thoughtful and empathetic in your approach. High-volume sales energize you, and you know how to balance speed with precision. You take pride in guiding prospects through the decision-making process with clarity, care, and confidence.

Naturally curious, you ask questions, look for smarter ways to work, and see feedback as an opportunity to grow. You love closing deals, and you're passionate about delivering proven results that move the business forward.

And if you love music like we do, even better!

Requirements

    

2+ years of experience in SaaS sales, preferably inbound or SMB-focused

    

Experience working with CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive

    

Excellent communication skills — fast, clear, and empathetic

    

Experience improving and optimizing sales and operational processes

    

Fluency in English and at least one of the following languages: German, French, or Spanish. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.

    

Based in Stockholm, Sweden.  

Preferred Qualifications

    

Experience supporting customers with audio hardware setups

    

Experience improving and optimizing sales and operational processes

Employee Benefits

    

We offer a flexible workplace with the possibility to work remotely

    

Generous pension plan

    

Yearly budget for health, wellness and personal development

    

Laptop and mobile phone of your choice with included cellular subscription

    

Regular social activities such as team events, meet ups, after works and off-sites

    

Daily breakfast served at the office

At Soundtrack, we believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, abilities, religions, sexual orientations, and identities.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we identify a suitable candidate before the application deadline. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted via our career page and do not accept applications by e-mail.

title: Automotive Program & Cost Controller
description:
In this role, you will support the financial management and development of vehicle programs across key milestones and throughout the product lifecycle. As the financial controller for assigned model-year programs, you will partner closely with Program Management and cross-functional teams to provide financial transparency, enable informed decision-making, and support efficient program execution.

The position covers both program investments and vehicle profitability, combining strategic financial planning with hands-on business controlling. You will collaborate with stakeholders across functions such as Program Management, Research & Development, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Planning, Volume Planning, and Finance.

The role also involves close collaboration with external partners and manufacturing organizations responsible for providing development cost quotations, investment estimates, and production-related financial data.

You will contribute to key financial planning cycles, including forecasting, budgeting, and long-term business planning, covering investment expenditure, product costs, and vehicle profitability for your assigned programs.

In addition to program controlling, the position includes financial controlling responsibilities related to manufacturing plants, providing exposure to both program finance and product/manufacturing cost controlling.

Key Responsibilities

    

Manage and communicate the financial development of model-year programs against agreed targets, budgets, and milestones.

    

Act as a financial business partner to Program Management, providing reliable financial information, analysis, and decision support throughout the program lifecycle.

    

Serve as a key point of contact for program-related financial topics across Finance and operational functions.

    

Consolidate, analyse, and present investment, cost, and profitability information for key program milestones, including variance analysis and explanations of underlying business drivers.

    

Support decisions concerning capital expenditure (CAPEX), product profitability, and short- and long-term financial planning through analyses, business cases, and financial investigations.

    

Coordinate financial input from multiple functions to ensure accurate and consistent program planning, forecasting, and reporting.

    

Manage financial controlling activities related to manufacturing operations, ensuring robust reporting, analysis, and assessment of financial performance.

    

Analyse manufacturing and transfer-pricing structures in close cooperation with relevant finance and controlling stakeholders.

    

Develop and support business cases and financial investigations related to manufacturing operations, including Bill of Material (BOM) development, cost-improvement initiatives, and cost-reduction tracking.

    

Identify financial risks and opportunities and provide actionable insights to relevant stakeholders.

What Will Make You Successful

You have a strong analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex financial and operational information. You can translate detailed data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with stakeholders from different functions and levels of the organization.

You enjoy working in a cross-functional and international environment and are comfortable balancing strategic financial planning with operational business support. You are structured, proactive, and able to coordinate inputs from multiple stakeholders while maintaining a clear view of deadlines, priorities, and financial targets.

Competence Requirements

    

3–10 years of experience in financial controlling or financial analyst roles.

    

Excellent analytical capabilities.

    

Strong Excel skills and experience handling data.

    

Experience in controlling, including setting targets and monitoring performance against them.

    

Strong project management skills, with the ability to act as a central point for coordinating and consolidating input from numerous internal stakeholders.

    

Understanding of potential cost and revenue drivers within the automotive industry.

Other Requirements

    

Self-motivated and driven, with a proactive approach to resolving issues and identifying potential improvements.

    

Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with multiple stakeholders.

    

A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Production Supervisor, Machining D&M  Husqvarna Group
description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

Would you like to develop both people and processes in a modern manufacturing environment?

We are now looking for an engaged and driven Production Supervisor to join Machining D&M in Huskvarna. In this position, you will combine close and supportive leadership with a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery and continuous improvement. You will be an important member of the D&M management team, with the opportunity to influence both daily operations and the and the strategy of the business.

About the role

As Production Supervisor, you will be responsible for the day-to-day leadership and operations within Machining D&M. Through visible, supportive and coaching leadership, you will develop the organization while keeping people, safety and performance at the center.

You will have direct responsibility for a team of process operators and technicians. You will also work closely with colleagues within quality, engineering, maintenance and logistics to ensure that the organization achieves its targets.

An important part of the role is to lead continuous improvement activities in line with HOS, the Husqvarna Operating System, and to ensure that the department meets our high standards for quality, delivery performance and operational efficiency.

Your main responsibilities will include

    Leading the daily operations and performance of Machining D&M
    Managing, coaching and developing a team of process operators and technicians
    Ensuring achievement of targets within safety, quality, delivery and cost
    Driving continuous improvement and operational excellence in line with HOS
    Developing people, capabilities and a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement

About you

You are a confident, clear and engaging leader with a genuine interest in both people and technology. You create involvement, build strong teams and drive development through a coaching and supportive leadership style.

You enjoy working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where change and continuous improvement are natural parts of everyday work. You are comfortable setting expectations and following up on results, while remaining present and accessible to your team.

To succeed in the role, we also believe that you are collaborative, structured and able to turn operational challenges into practical actions and improvements.

Your skills and background

    Experience of leading employees within a manufacturing environment, for example as a team leader
    Experience of driving continuous improvement and change initiatives
    A good understanding of manufacturing processes and operational development
    The ability to analyze results and translate them into concrete actions
    Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be considered an advantage:

    HOS, Lean or a comparable production system
    CNC machining or other machining operations
    Work environment management and rehabilitation processes
    Post-secondary education within engineering, production, manufacturing or leadership

Location

This position is based in Huskvarna, Sweden.

How we work

As a Production Supervisor, you will be a hands-on leader in our production environment, working closely with your team and the wider organization every day. Your physical presence on site is essential to ensure smooth operations, enable fast decision-making, foster collaboration and provide visible, supportive leadership.

We believe that being close to the operation and the people who make it happen creates the best conditions for learning, continuous improvement and great results. This role is based full time on site.

Your application

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person.

For more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Niclas Thulin niclas.thulin@husqvarnagroup.com

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Kristin Sundlo Kristin.sundlo@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application, we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people. As a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work and bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

title: Head of Safety
description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as our Head of Safety at Esrange Space Center.

At Esrange Space Center, safety is fundamental to everything we do. Our operations include sounding rocket and balloon launches, rocket testing, and the development of orbital launch capabilities – activities that place high demands on safety, coordination and regulatory compliance.

As Head of Safety, you will lead and coordinate the overall safety work at Esrange Space Center. Your mission is to ensure a safe environment for employees, customers, contractors, visitors and the public across operations that include rocket and balloon launches, testing and future orbital launch activities.

You will set the frameworks and requirements for our safety work and lead experts within areas such as range safety, flight and campaign safety, occupational health and safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness. This is a strategic role with a strong operational focus, significant decision-making authority, and close collaboration with internal teams, authorities, and local stakeholders.

REQUIREMENTS

    A relevant degree in engineering, safety, risk management, HSE or fire protection, or equivalent experience.
    At least five years of safety or HSE experience from a regulated industrial or operational environment.
    Experience leading specialists and coordinating safety across several functions.
    Experience developing and maintaining safety management systems.
    Strong knowledge of risk management, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance.
    Experience working with authorities, permits, and external stakeholders.
    Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Experience from aviation, airports, aerospace, defence or another safety-critical field is highly valued. Knowledge of flight safety, airspace coordination, Seveso, explosive materials, ADR, or systematic fire protection is an advantage.

You are an analytical and confident leader who remains calm under pressure. You combine structure and integrity with a practical approach and are comfortable making difficult decisions when safety is at stake. You also know how to build trust, challenge unsafe practices, and turn requirements into effective action.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Lead and develop the overall safety function and Safety Management System at Esrange.
    Ensure clear safety frameworks, processes, and responsibilities.
    Coordinate the Esrange Safety Board and safety preparations for launches, tests and campaigns.
    Lead and coordinate safety specialists across range safety, flight safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness.
    Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, permits and authority requirements.
    Develop the site-wide crisis and emergency response organization, including training and exercises.
    Coordinate airspace, impact-area and public-safety matters with authorities and external stakeholders.
    Oversee incident management, safety planning, budgeting and continuous improvement.

WE OFFER YOU

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position is security-sensitive and requires approved security vetting and background check in accordance with the protective security act. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Piping Team Leader
description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We are participating in a project where Stegra AB establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ Piping Team Leaders. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

Job Description

The Piping Team Leader is responsible for supervising and coordinating all piping installation and maintenance activities on site. This role involves leading a team of piping fitters and related personnel to ensure piping systems are installed, assembled, and maintained according to engineering drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Piping Team Leader ensures work is completed efficiently, safely, and within project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead and supervise piping crews, including piping fitters and support personnel, during installation and maintenance activities.

· Review and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, piping isometrics, and technical specifications.

· Plan, organize, and assign daily work activities to ensure project schedules and deadlines are met.

· Oversee installation, alignment, and assembly of piping systems, valves, pumps, and associated equipment.

· Ensure proper pipe routing, supports, fittings, and installation methods in accordance with engineering requirements.

· Monitor work progress and ensure high standards of quality and workmanship.

· Coordinate with welding teams, mechanical crews, engineers, and supervisors to ensure smooth project execution.

· Conduct routine inspections of piping installations and ensure compliance with project specifications and industry standards.

· Ensure all work activities comply with company safety policies, site safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Identify and resolve technical or installation issues that arise during project execution.

· Maintain records of work progress, manpower utilization, and materials usage.

· Provide technical guidance, training, and support to piping crew members when necessary.

Qualifications

· Experience in piping installation and maintenance in industrial, construction, or plant environments is preferred.

· Experience as a Piping Fitter or similar role, with leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

· Strong ability to read and interpret piping drawings, isometric drawings, and technical documentation.

· Knowledge of piping materials, fittings, valves, installation techniques, and industry standards.

· Understanding of safety procedures and construction site practices.

Skills and Competencies

· Leadership and team management skills

· Strong technical knowledge of piping systems

· Planning and organizational ability

· Problem-solving and decision-making skills

· Strong communication and coordination skills

· Commitment to quality and safety standards

Our headquarters are in Stockholm, and applications are received via the specified e-mail address.

title: Program Controller to premium EV brand!
description:
Are you an analytical controller with a passion for the automotive industry and product lifecycles? Do you thrive in cross-functional, international environments where your financial insights directly shape key strategic decisions? Then this might be your next opportunity!

About the position

Perido is looking for a Program Controller to join our client, a leading global premium EV brand. This positions is located in Gothenburg.

In this role, you will hold a key position supporting the development and financial steering of vehicle programs throughout key program milestones. You will work closely with Program Management and cross-functional stakeholders—including R&D, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Office, Volume Planning, and Finance—to ensure financial transparency and drive efficient program execution. The position uniquely combines program controlling across the full product lifecycle with financial controlling within a major automotive group, covering joint venture production and strategic sister-brand operations. providing broad exposure to both program and product cost controlling. You will also engage in close cooperation with international counterparts.

Your daily tasks

    Drive and communicate the financial progression of model year programs against established targets and milestones
    Serve as a key financial partner to program management, providing quality-assured financial data to support decision-making throughout the program lifecycle
    Act as the primary contact for program-related financial matters, both within Finance and towards operational stakeholders
    Secure, analyze, and deliver investment (CAPEX), cost, and profitability data for program milestones, including clear explanations of variances and underlying business drivers
    Actively participate in all financial planning processes, including Forecasts, Budget, and Business Planning (BPL), covering investment spend and vehicle profitability
    Lead financial controlling activities for manufacturing plants, ensuring robust reporting, analyses, and financial performance assessments aligned with business realities
    Perform financial analyses of transfer prices from manufacturing plants in close collaboration with transfer pricing controllers

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you possess a strong analytical mindset and the ability to translate complex financial information into actionable business insights. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and international environment, balancing strategic financial planning with operational business support. As a person, you are self-motivated, driven, and proactive when it comes to solving issues and suggesting improvements. You possess excellent communication skills and have a proven ability to build strong working relationships with multiple stakeholders.

Does this sound like an exciting challenge for you? We look forward to receiving your application—apply today!

Qualifications:

    Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent academic background
    3–10 years of experience in financial controlling or analyst roles, including experience setting and following up targets
    Outstanding analytical capabilities
    Very strong skills in Excel and complex data handling
    Strong project management skills, acting as the key link and center for inputs from numerous internal stakeholders
    Excellent communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

Meritorious:

    Understanding of potential cost and revenue drivers within the automotive industry
    Experience with product cost structures, BOM development, or transfer pricing

Contract type and hours

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-02-28. Start 2026-10-01.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations.

Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

Responsible recruiter: charlotte.crowley@perido.se

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36008 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

title: Senior Automation  Engineer -SCADA
description:
Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADA

About the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.

Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:

    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.
    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.
    Design & Commissioning: Hands-on experience in design and commissioning of HVAC Substations (specifically 66/132kV). This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.
    Process & Risk Management: Able to follow the process, identify gaps and risks, and propose solution recommendations to ensure the operational integrity of our SAS/SCADA systems remains optimal.
    Protocol Proficiency: Competence in configuring and troubleshooting standard industry protocols, including IEC61850, IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, and Modbus.
    Testing & Execution: Preparation of signal lists, commissioning reports, and active participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
    Cybersecurity & Networking: Enforcement of cybersecurity adherence, user profile management on SAS systems, and configuration of Ethernet switches, VLANs, and network redundancy.
    Why Join Us? As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. If you have a proven track record of maintaining conducive operational environments and delivering high-quality automation engineering solutions, we encourage you to apply.

title: Director, Business Development Data Centers
description:

title: Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology
description:
Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology

About the Role:

We are seeking a structured and commercially minded Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology to join our team.

In this role, you will support company management and ongoing green technology projects by combining project coordination, business analysis, quantitative modelling, technical research, and operational administration.

Working closely with management and project stakeholders, you will organize project information, maintain yield and cost models, evaluate scenarios, support financial and commercial analysis, and translate operational data into structured business information and decision-support material.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Coordination

Support company management with ongoing commercial and technical projects, including tracking deliverables, action points, schedules, project information and administrative follow-ups.

Quantitative Excel Modelling

Develop and maintain Excel-based calculation models and prototypes for process yields, quantities, volumes, pricing, costs, revenues and other project-related calculations.

Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis

Prepare scenario, sensitivity and comparative calculations to assess how changes in operational assumptions may affect commercial outcomes, costs, risks and project viability.

Process & Technical Data Analysis

Research and analyze information relating to thermolysis/pyrolysis processes, feedstocks, process outputs and relevant by-products, and incorporate relevant data into commercial and financial models.

Commercial Data Translation

Translate technical and operational assumptions into practical commercial models, business cases, analyses and presentations suitable for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Content Development

Prepare and maintain technical, commercial and administrative documentation, reports, presentations, visual materials and other project-related content.

Financial Administration

Support general financial administration, preliminary bookkeeping, invoice verification, cost tracking and project budget follow-ups.

Digital & Information Management

Maintain and organize project information through SharePoint and other digital systems, and assist with maintaining the company's website and LinkedIn presence.

Operational & Management Support

Provide direct administrative and operational support to company management and act as a coordination point for information flow between management, project teams and external contacts.

Qualifications & Experience

    Relevant professional experience in project coordination, business analysis, business administration, operations, financial administration or a related field.
    Demonstrated experience working with Microsoft Excel, including developing and maintaining quantitative calculation models.
    Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to work with operational, commercial and financial data.
    Ability to translate operational and process data into structured commercial and financial analysis.
    Strong organizational, administrative and project coordination skills.
    Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and follow up on details.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Ability to prepare clear professional documentation, presentations and visual materials.
    Experience with SharePoint, digital content management, website administration and LinkedIn/social media is an advantage.
    Familiarity with or interest in green technology, circular economy, thermolysis/pyrolysis processes and their products and by-products is an advantage.

The position requires a versatile and technically curious professional who can combine administrative, analytical, technical and communication responsibilities and work closely with company management.

title: EY-Parthenon | Engagement Manager | Strategy & Execution - Value Creation
description:
The opportunity



At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.



EY-Parthenon is looking for Senior Consultants and Engagement Managers to join our Strategy & Execution team in the Nordics, focused on private equity value creation across deals and transactions. We are growing a dedicated capability at the intersection of strategy, operational performance and private equity. Our team supports clients throughout the investment lifecycle, helping translate investment theses into measurable results through growth acceleration, performance improvement, value creation planning and exit readiness.



Whether your experience comes from consulting, private equity, strategy, transaction advisory or industry, we welcome individuals who enjoy solving complex business challenges, working collaboratively and creating tangible impact.





Your key responsibilities



You will work closely with private equity investors, management teams and senior stakeholders to identify, shape and deliver value creation opportunities. Combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, you will help clients navigate critical business decisions and transformation initiatives.



Examples of your work may include:



    Developing value creation plans by identifying and quantifying commercial, operational and financial improvement opportunities
    Advising investors and portfolio companies on growth, transformation and operational performance
    Conducting operational and value creation due diligence
    Supporting execution through governance structures, KPI frameworks and initiative tracking
    Designing operating models and organisational structures that support long-term growth
    Preparing businesses for exit and communicating value creation outcomes
    Leveraging data, analytics and AI to accelerate value creation





Skills and attributes for success



We are looking for collaborative and commercially minded individuals who enjoy solving complex business challenges with clients and colleagues.



    Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering or other relevant field
    Relevant experience in consulting, transaction advisory, strategy, M&A, corporate development, private equity operations or a related field. For Engagement Manager candidates, experience leading project delivery and client relationships is beneficial.
    Experience of value creation, performance improvement, growth or operating model work, ideally in a transaction or private equity context
    Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills
    Fluent English skills; Nordic languages are considered an advantage





Ideally, you’ll also have:



    The ability to structure complex topics and analyses into actionable recommendations
    An understanding of the financial and operational drivers of a business
    Experience supporting implementation alongside management teams
    An interest in transactions, business transformation and value creation consulting





What we offer you



When you join EY-Parthenon, you become part of a collaborative and entrepreneurial team where you can take ownership early, continue developing your skills and contribute to meaningful client outcomes.



    Work on high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients
    Build experience across the full investment lifecycle, from diligence to ownership and exit
    Collaborate directly with private equity investors and senior management teams
    Learn from experienced colleagues and collaborate across Nordic, European and global value creation teams on joint engagements and opportunities
    Modern offices in central locations in Stockholm and Gothenburg, and flexible ways of working as part of our Nordic Hybrid Model



Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



The application deadline is 11 October 2026. Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.



EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Car Registration Specialist
description:
Car Registration Specialist

Location: Stockholm

About the us

Green SM is a leading electric vehicle (EV) and sustainable mobility solutions provider headquartered in Vietnam. With a commitment to transforming urban transportation, we have successfully expanded into the Global Market and are now preparing to launch operations in the EU Market. Join us in driving the future of sustainable mobility.



Website: Green SM - Electric Mobility Service, 5-Star Quality | Green SM



Position Overview

The Car Registration Specialist is responsible for supporting the end-to-end vehicle registration process to ensure GSM Europe’s EV fleet is legally ready for operation in the local market. This role will coordinate documentation, registration applications, insurance confirmation, license plates, and related administrative procedures to ensure vehicles are ready for deployment on time.

Key Responsibilities

    Support vehicle registration processes for GSM Denmark EV fleet across assigned markets
    Prepare and manage registration documents including CoC, vehicle titles, customs, insurance, and compliance paperwork
    Coordinate with transport authorities, registration offices, and external agencies to ensure legal compliance
    Monitor local EV regulations, registration requirements, tax incentives, and subsidy policies
    Execute and track bulk vehicle registrations to support operational launch timelines
    Follow vehicle status from delivery through license plate issuance and road readiness
    Coordinate with insurance providers and external partners to resolve registration issues and documentation gaps
    Manage license plate distribution, vehicle records, and fleet administration processes including deregistration and ownership transfer
    Collaborate closely with Logistics, Fleet Operations, Insurance, and local teams to ensure timely “Ready-to-Drive” vehicle deployment



Requirements

    Bachelor's degree in business administration, Logistics, Automotive, or related fields.
    2–4 years of experience in vehicle registration, fleet administration, leasing operations, logistics administration, or related fields.
    Understanding local vehicle registration processes and administrative requirements.
    Familiarity with electric vehicles, vehicle imports, or EV-related documentation is an advantage.
    Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple documents and cases at the same time.
    Good coordination skills with authorities, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
    Professional fluency in the local language and English.

Why Join GSM

    Be part of the founding European setup team and grow with us as we expand
    Backed by Vietnam's largest company, with the growth trajectory of a fast-scaling European startup
    Real decision-making authority with tangible, visible impact
    Learn alongside counterparts across other markets
    Help build the future of green transport in Europe

title: Compliance Model Validator | Swedbank
description:
Are you passionate about financial crime risk models?In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

• Perform independent model validations of models primarily used in the financial crime risk area, including both rule-based and machine learning models.

• Assess model risk from the aspects of model objective, design and construction, assumptions and limitations, data, implementation, model governance, and ongoing performance monitoring.

• Deliver high quality and value adding model validation reports which support effective and efficient model development and enhancements of the model risk management in the 1LoD.

• Proactively challenge the 1LoD in its activities to develop, maintain and monitor its models in a constructive and evidence-based manner, focusing on whether these models adequately mitigate the compliance risks in scope.

• Be part of our compliance continuous maturity journey and take an active role in supporting the bank in strengthening the tools and models to combat financial crime.

What is needed in this role:

• A degree in a quantitative field e.g. computer science, data science, data engineering, statistics, mathematics, or economics.

• Experience in data assembling and analysis of large datasets.

• Experience in SQL, querying and manipulating large databases.

• Experience in rule-based and machine learning models (both supervised and unsupervised learning), including relevant programming skills in Python.

• Experience from working with Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision trees, Random Forest, and Isolation Forest.

• Experience from working in Microsoft Azure.

• Familiarity with the retail banking industry, products and services offered, its compliance and operational risks, and preferably model risk management for AML/CTF/FS models.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to a non-technical audience, and to clearly articulate and defend validation findings, methodologies in discussions with stakeholders and senior management.

• Excellent collaboration skills, enabling effective teamwork and good team spirit.

• Strong self-leadership, including the ability to drive and complete tasks independently and deliver to tight timelines.

• Proactive, engaged, and motivated to continuously learn and deepen your expertise in model risk management and model validation.

• Excellent communication skills in both oral and written English.

• Ready to enjoy working in an international environment with colleagues based in multiple locations.

With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.

"Join our team and...

be part of a diverse, internationally oriented group of people, who keep oversight on the models that Swedbank uses to protect itself and society against compliance risks such as money laundering, terrorist financing, and financial sanctions. Join us in fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment where your skills are not only valued but essential for our success” Fredrik Sandstedt, your future manager

We look forward to receiving your application by 13.10.2026. We work with continuous selection, which means that the position may be filled before the application deadline. As a result, the job advertisement may be closed earlier than expected.

title: Controller Financial Planning and Analysis
description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Support financial performance in a growing global business



Do you want to play a key role in supporting strategic decision-making and financial performance in a global organization contributing to the energy transition? As Controller Financial Planning and Analysis, you will join a Finance Controlling team in Karlskrona, supporting the global Grid Solutions business line.







This is an exciting opportunity to work close to management, contribute to business decisions through financial insights, and contribute to a growing international organization delivering solutions that enable the expansion of renewable energy infrastructure worldwide.







Support strategic decisions through financial insight



As Controller Financial Planning and Analysis, you will be part of a global FP & A team supporting financial planning, performance management and reporting across the Grid Solutions hubs. Working closely with management, Shared Service Center teams and stakeholders across the organization, you will provide financial transparency and valuable insights that support both strategic and operational decisions.







Key responsibilities include:




    Contribute to strategic and operational financial planning activities
    Forecasting, budgeting, month-end closing and reporting processes
    Analyze financial performance and provide recommendations to management
    Ensure compliance with IFRS, internal controls and group standards
    Support financial statements, audits and tax-related activities







The position is based in Karlskrona and is part of the FP & A and Finance Controlling organization supporting the global Grid Solutions business line. Collaboration with international stakeholders is an important part of the role.







Controller who brings a business perspective



You are a collaborative and structured professional who thrives in an international environment. Curious and engaged, you combine solid analytical and communication skills with a genuine interest in the business. You navigate complexity with ease, build trusted relationships and turn insights into practical improvements.







Key qualifications




    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration or a related field
    Minimum five years of FP & A or controlling experience in a corporate environment
    Knowledge of planning, forecasting, budgeting and financial reporting processes
    Proficiency in SAP, OneStream, BI tools and advanced Excel
    Fluent Swedish and English skills, both written and spoken







Shape business performance in a global growth journey



NKT is committed to creating a diverse workplace and an environment where individuals from many backgrounds can thrive and bring their best work forward. We believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better place to work.





At NKT, you can advance your career in an international team-oriented environment where your efforts contribute to important outcomes. You will collaborate closely with business and finance leaders across several countries, gain wide-ranging exposure to strategic and operational finance, and expand your capabilities in financial planning, controlling, and business partnering. As part of a company supporting the expansion of renewable energy infrastructure, you will contribute to projects that help shape a more sustainable future.







"As a leader, I believe in empowering people through trust, collaboration and continuous development. title: HR Specialist
description:
Be part of Clavister’s journey to secure the digital world! We are looking for an HR Specialist who wants to take an active role across the employee lifecycle and help us deliver effective, people-focused and scalable HR practices.

We apply Agile HR principles, working closely with the organisation, learning through feedback and data, and continuously adapting our people practices as our needs evolve. This is a broad and hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys combining people interaction with structure, independent responsibility and continuous improvement.

About Clavister

Clavister is a leading European cybersecurity company founded in 1997, headquartered in Örnsköldsvik, offering a wide range of cybersecurity solutions, including network firewalls, identity management, cloud security, machine learning and AI.

Today, we focus on four main customer segments: the Public Sector, Critical Infrastructure, Defence and Telecommunications. Together with our partners and distributors, Clavister’s hardware and software are widely deployed and used by customers in more than 100 countries.

The Role

As HR Specialist, you will work closely with our Head of HR. You will independently manage and coordinate defined HR processes and support employees and leaders throughout the employee lifecycle.

You will have a broad role spanning recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, HR administration and data, work environment activities and day-to-day HR support. You will be responsible for ensuring that the processes within your area are well structured, professionally delivered and continuously improved.

This is a role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, creating structure and making sure things get done, while providing a professional and positive experience for candidates, employees and People Leads.

Key areas of responsibility

    

Manage recruitment processes, including candidate communication, interview coordination and recruitment administration

    

Coordinate and continuously improve onboarding and offboarding processes

    

Coordinate activities, documentation and follow-up related to Systematic Work Environment (SAM) Management and the Safety Committee

    

Maintain accurate employee information, HR systems, documentation and records

You will also contribute to

    

Provide HR support to employees and People Leads, handling routine matters and working together with the Head of HR on more complex questions

    

Prepare and validate employee and compensation data for reporting, analysis and recurring HR processes

    

Support recurring HR activities related to engagement, communication, performance and employee development

    

Support personnel security activities throughout the employee lifecycle

    

Work closely with employees and People Leads to understand needs, gather feedback and improve HR practices

Across all these areas, you will work with an Agile HR mindset, staying close to the organisation, learning from feedback and continuously improving our processes, tools and ways of working.

The person we are looking for

Trust is our foundation, and how you work with people matters to us. We are looking for someone who combines a genuine interest in people with the structure and drive to take ownership and get things done.

You have experience working with HR and independently managing defined HR activities or processes. You understand the employee lifecycle, are comfortable managing several priorities at once, and communicate confidently in both Swedish and English.

We believe you will thrive at Clavister if you:

    

Care about people and take pride in creating a positive and professional experience for others

    

Collaborate openly, build strong relationships and enjoy working closely with employees and leaders

    

Show bravery by taking initiative, asking questions and challenging ways of working when you see an opportunity to improve

    

Innovate by being curious and looking for smarter ways of working, including how technology can improve everyday HR

    

Keep growing by seeking feedback, learning and adapting as the needs of our people and organisation evolve

    

Take ownership of your work while having the judgement to recognise when something should be discussed or escalated

You are structured and reliable and comfortable working iteratively, learning from feedback and adjusting along the way. You understand when consistency and structure are important and when a simpler, more flexible approach creates greater value.

Extra points for

Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage:

    

Recruitment and onboarding

    

Swedish work environment processes and employment practices

    

HR systems, employee data or HR reporting

    

HR analytics

    

Agile HR or working in an agile organisation

    

Technology, international or regulated organisations

We will continuously review and interview qualified applicants.

title: Business Controller needed in Södertälje
description:

As a Project Controller at our client, you’ll work closely with project managers and leadership teams, supporting key decisions and driving financial performance across a portfolio of exciting projects.

About the position

Perido are looking for an experienced Business Controller for our client, a world-leading supplier of transport solutions and together with partners and customers, they are driving the transition to a sustainable transport system. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain a broad understanding of project-driven business operations and collaborate closely with stakeholders across engineering, sales, purchasing, production, and finance. The position is located at the company's headquarters in Södertälje. You are expected to be minimum 3 days on site.

Your daily tasks

As a Project Controller, you will play a key role in supporting and steering a portfolio of both product development projects and customer-related business projects. Acting as a finance business partner and trusted advisor to project managers and management teams, you will ensure transparency, financial control, and informed decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Your characteristics

We are looking for a proactive and analytical individual who enjoys working in a project-oriented environment and translating complex information into actionable insights. You combine a solid financial foundation with a genuine interest in business operations and project management. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, asking the right questions, and supporting decision-makers with both strategic perspectives and attention to detail.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

Qualifications:

    A university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Industrial Economics, Engineering, or a related field
    Experience in controlling, financial analysis, project controlling, business controlling, or project management support
    Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to understand technical, commercial, and financial drivers
    Experience working with budgets, forecasts, business cases, and financial reporting
    Excellent communication and presentation skills, enabling you to explain financial matters to non-financial stakeholders
    A collaborative mindset and the ability to build strong relationships across functions and organizational levels

Full-time consulting assignment until 2028-09-21. Start asap.

title: Payroll Manager
description:
We’re looking for a Payroll Manager for a company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

﻿

Daily tasks﻿

• Ensure accurate, compliant and timely end-to-end payroll delivery within a large and complex Swedish payroll environment.

• Lead, support and set priorities for the payroll team, ensuring operational stability and clear ownership.

• Monitor payroll quality, controls, risks and service performance, taking action where issues arise.

• Drive process improvements, digitalisation and automation to reduce manual work and strengthen efficiency.

• Translate operational needs into clear priorities for payroll systems, integrations and longer-term development.

﻿

• Extensive hands-on knowledge of Swedish end-to-end payroll within a large or complex organisation.

﻿

Leadership and experience level

• Senior Payroll Manager or equivalent leadership-level experience within a large and complex Swedish organisation.

• Able to balance strategic direction with hands-on operational judgement and decisive issue resolution.

• Demonstrated ability to stabilise payroll delivery while building clear structures, governance, processes and longer-term development plans.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and align payroll priorities across senior stakeholders and specialist functions.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Döttingen verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachkräften in der Geriatrie, da der demografische Wandel den Bedarf an qualifiziertem Personal kontinuierlich steigert. - Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Geriatrie in Döttingen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

![Association les Châtaigniers]( )

L’Association Les Châtaigniers exploite un établissement médico\-social (EMS), une organisation d’aide et de soins à domicile (OSAD) ainsi qu’une organisation d’ergothérapie. Elle considère que la qualité des prestations repose avant tout sur les femmes et les hommes qui les rendent possibles.



Elle développe une organisation fondée sur la compétence, la responsabilité, la confiance, la transparence et l’amélioration continue. Chaque membre du personnel participe activement à une gouvernance clinique exigeante, favorisant le développement des compétences, la coopération interprofessionnelle et l'innovation organisationnelle.



L’Association inscrit l’ensemble de ses activités dans une démarche de management intégré visant à garantir la qualité des prestations, la sécurité des personnes accompagnées, la santé et la sécurité de ses collaborateurs, la protection de l’environnement et l’amélioration continue de ses pratiques.

**ICUS 1 – Infirmier/ère coordinateur/trice d'unité de soins**

En qualité d’Infirmier(ère) coordinateur(trice) d'unité de soins (ICUS), vous exercez les missions fondamentales de la profession infirmière, auxquelles s’ajoutent des responsabilités de coordination clinique, d'organisation des soins, d'encadrement des équipes et d'amélioration continue de la qualité.



Vous participez quotidiennement à la pratique clinique et à la réalisation des soins, tout en garantissant leur organisation, leur continuité, leur sécurité et leur conformité aux exigences professionnelles et institutionnelles.



Vos missions comprennent notamment :



* L’évaluation clinique des besoins en soins ;
* le raisonnement clinique ;
* la planification des interventions ;
* la coordination interprofessionnelle ;
* la réalisation des prestations infirmières ;
* la délégation et la supervision des activités de soins ;
* la documentation clinique ;
* la communication avec les résidants, les bénéficiaires, leurs proches et les partenaires du réseau ;
* la prévention et la promotion de la santé ;
* la qualité, la sécurité et la gestion des risques ;
* l’encadrement, la formation et le développement des compétences des professionnels.


**Profil recherché**



Vous êtes un·e infirmier·ère diplômé·e appelé·e à exercer une fonction d'encadrement de proximité conciliant pratique clinique, coordination des soins, organisation des prestations et développement des compétences professionnelles.



Vous répondez notamment aux conditions suivantes :



* Bachelor of Science HES\-SO en soins infirmiers, diplôme d'infirmier·ère ES ou titre suisse ou étranger permettant l'exercice de la profession en Suisse ; les titres étrangers doivent être reconnus par la Croix\-Rouge suisse conformément aux dispositions applicables ;
* autorisation de pratiquer dans le canton de Genève obtenue au plus tard à l’entrée en fonction ;
* expérience professionnelle confirmée en gériatrie dans l'accompagnement, les soins et la coordination des prestations destinées aux personnes âgées ; une expérience en psychogériatrie constitue un atout ;
* adhésion aux valeurs et au projet institutionnel de l'Association Les Châtaigniers ;
* personnalité professionnelle agile, participative, engagée, faisant preuve de discernement, de sens des responsabilités et d'un intérêt marqué pour le travail interprofessionnel ;
* aptitude démontrée à exercer un management de proximité favorisant la collaboration, le développement des compétences et la qualité des soins ;
* maîtrise des outils numériques professionnels du domaine des soins, notamment du dossier informatisé du résidant, des systèmes d'information cliniques et des outils collaboratifs ; la connaissance du modèle PLAISIR constitue un atout ;
* bonne maîtrise de l'environnement Microsoft 365, notamment Word, Excel et Outlook.


Une formation postgrade en management, gouvernance clinique, qualité, gériatrie, psychogériatrie, prévention et contrôle des infections, soins palliatifs ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent est souhaitée.



En l’absence d’une telle formation, la personne retenue s'engage à entreprendre une formation adaptée aux responsabilités du poste dans un délai convenu avec l'Association.



**Nous offrons**



Un environnement de travail interprofessionnel, au sein d’une institution à taille humaine ;



* la possibilité de contribuer activement à l’évolution des pratiques, à la qualité des soins et aux projets institutionnels ;
* des possibilités de formation continue et de développement professionnel ;
* une rémunération selon l’échelle des traitements de l’État de Genève ;
* des repas à prix préférentiel pour les collaborateurs ;
* un environnement verdoyant et agréable à Veyrier.
