SachbearbeiterIn Finanzwesen
============================

Hochwald ist eine attraktive und gut vernetzte Gemeinde auf dem wunderschönen Gempenplateau. Wir sind innerhalb der Agglomeration Basel gut zu erreichen und bieten eine hohe Lebensqualität und ein attraktives Dorfleben. Das Verwaltungsteam setzt sich täglich im Namen der Gemeinde für seine Anspruchsgruppen ein und legt Wert auf kompetente Dienstleistungen, nachhaltige und pragmatische Lösungen und engagiert sich in der Zusammenarbeit der Gemeinden: Die Verwaltung Hochwald ist auch für die Einwohnerkontrolle und Finanzverwaltung von Gempen zuständig. Wir suchen per 1\. November 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung

 

### **eine Sachbearbeiterin / einen Sachbearbeiter Finanzen 60%**

 

**Diese Aufgaben warten auf Sie:**

* Sie sind verantwortlich für die Kreditoren\- und Debitorenbuchhaltung der Gemeinde Gempen und erledigen auch das Mahnwesen.
* Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für die Bereiche Steuern und Gebühren der Gemeinde Gempen und teilweise auch von der Gemeinde Hochwald.
* Nach Möglichkeit übernehmen Sie weitere Aufgaben wie zum Beispiel die Mehrwertsteuerabrechnung und Aufgaben im Rahmen des Budget\- und Abschlussprozesses.
* Sie erledigen die Personaladministration (Lohnwesen, Personalversicherungen) beider Gemeinden selbständig.


Wir können uns gut vorstellen, dass Sie bei Interesse und Eignung in das Fachgebiet des Finanzverwalters weiter eingearbeitet werden und Stellvertretungsaufgaben übernehmen.

 

**Sie bringen mit:**

Für diese Aufgabe mit hoher Eigenverantwortung suchen wir eine Fachperson, welche mit Erfahrung und Freude in unserem Team arbeitet. Sie haben bereits:

* eine Grundausbildung in der öffentlichen Verwaltung,
* Berufserfahrung im Bereich Finanzen einer Solothurner Gemeinde,
* gute MS\-Office\- und wenn möglich HiSoft\-Kenntnisse.


Gute IT\-Fähigkeiten setzen wir voraus. Sie denken und handeln vernetzt, arbeiten strukturiert und lösungs\-orientiert und sind belastbar. Grosses Gewicht legen wir auch auf Selbständigkeit, gute Kommunikations\-fähigkeiten und auf eine zielorientierte und effiziente Arbeitsorganisation.

 

**Das wartet auf Sie:**

Es erwartet Sie ein eingespieltes Team und eine gut organisierte und moderne Verwaltung. Wir bieten Ihnen als Teamplayerin oder Teamplayer viel Eigenverantwortung und ein vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld an einem sehr schönen Arbeitsort mit gut eingerichteten Büroräumlichkeiten in Hochwald. Zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und die Möglichkeit, sich für den Ort einzubringen sind für uns selbstverständlich.

 

**Interessiert?**

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen elektronisch an Gemeindepräsident Beat Kübler, welcher Ihnen auch gerne für Fragen zur Verfügung steht. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennen zu lernen.

title: University Admissions Counsellor
description:
Role Description La Garenne International School would like to appoint a University Admissions Counsellor to help guide our students through their learning journey and work closely with colleagues and parents to ensure that a personalised pathway is clearly defi ned for each student.
The role incorporates a wide range of responsibilities, including but not limited to: Leadership &

Collaboration
● The implementation and oversight of the Higher Education & Futures (HEF) programme, ensuring that we fulfi ll the 8 Gatsby Benchmarks
● Work closely with the school’s HEF Coordinator to ensure a collaborative and systematic approach to preparing our Secondary School students for university admission.
● Working closely with other HEF providers to facilitate a comprehensive and personalised approach to HEF support for Secondary School students
● The maintenance of personalised HEF pathways for individual students across the Secondary School
● Liaising with colleagues across schools departments (e.g. Subject Coordinators, Learning Support, Boarding, School Counsellor) to ensure that you have the whole picture of each student, aiding pathway personalisation and tailoring both Teacher and Counsellor references
● Regular, proactive consultation with students and parents to establish and refi ne HEF pathways
● Taking responsibility for country-specifi c application processes
● Leading in-house student and staff workshops

Organisation & Administration
● Supporting the HEF Coordinator in the creation and maintenance of a HEF Calendar which includes all key dates pertaining to careers, university guidance, supra-curricular / personal development opportunities
● Support in managing and updating HEF development, tracking and application systems, including (but not limited to) Unifrog, CommonApp and UCAS, ensuring that student data is kept up to date and the development of each student’s progress is closely monitored with appropriate interventions in place
● Support in coordinating and overseeing the application process in its entirety with distinct groups of students; reference-writing and collation, sourcing and uploading student transcripts, supporting all written application material (e.g. UCAS personal statement, Common App essays, US College supplementary essays, Letters of Intention etc.), uploading references and both sourcing and providing quality assurance throughout this process, ahead of fi nal submission
● Support in managing and facilitating access and support with SAT, IELTS and other HEF pathway assessments/admission tests and interview preparation, as required, including registration, portal administration and oversight of logistics, including access arrangements
● Support in arranging local and international university visits depending upon the interests of the students, in addition to ensuring our attendance at local university fairs and other events which could help to strengthen university applications
● Support in coordinating programmes of seminars, webinars and subject-specifi c workshops/ one-to-ones related to the HEF programme
● Working with the Marketing Team to promote and celebrate the HEF programme at La Garenne
● Support with the organisation of an annual ‘Futures Week’ for the Secondary School students
● Communicate regularly with families to provide application and progress updates General duties
● Ensuring your availability (on campus / remotely, as required) following the release of external examination results, supporting the analysis and evaluation of HEF pathways, liaising with colleagues, students and families as required
● Pursuing appropriate professional development, including attendance at annual conference(s) related to HEF pathways and provision
● Teaching responsibilities related to your subject area, as required by school and in consideration of the demands of the role (note that a non-teaching role may be more appropriate / preferred)
● Demonstrating a professional, friendly and respectful attitude towards all members of the La Garenne community at all times
● Assisting with other duties as assigned by the Head of Section, School Principal or General Director, in response to school needs

Expectations of all teachers
All teachers are required to carry out rota duties to ensure that students can be safely supervised across both campuses at all times and to ensure better communication beyond the classroom. As part of their commitment to school life, teaching staff members are expected to attend all events (see list below) and should be prepared to accompany children on other day or residential trips within Switzerland or beyond if required.

● Parent/Teacher Days (during the school day)
● Student parties (Halloween, Christmas & End of Year Celebration)
● Staff Christmas Party
● Supporting weekend study sessions if required (Saturday morning)
● Overnight Group Expedition (All full time Teachers should accompany once a year; 1 night 2 days) ● Boarding duties on a rota basis (if required)
● Ski Race (during the school day) and Medal Presentation Ceremony
● Charity Days (during the school day)
● School Challenge Days (usually on Sunday afternoons)
● Sports Day (during the school day)
● School Show & End of Year Ceremony (during the school day)

The Ideal Candidate
You will be an educator who is dedicated to continual improvement and embodies the attributes of the IB Learner Profi le.

● Has a good honours degree and/or a further degree
● Embraces a commitment to working within the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion
● Is passionate about their specialist teaching subject and can enthuse others
● Embraces developments and innovations in teaching and learning and is willing to experiment with new practices
● Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
● Shares the educational vision of La Garenne International School including our holistic vision of education and is excited to contribute to the co-curricular and pastoral aspects of life at the school
● Has strong interpersonal skills and can build relationships and collaborate with colleagues and the school leadership
● Has experience in dealing with university admissions
● Experience working in a boarding school setting
● A proven track record of taking initiative
● An understanding of university admissions procedures or a strong willingness to learn
● Familiarity with the IB Diploma Programme and ideally the US High School Diploma
● Possesses a positive outlook, an optimistic approach to change and development, and a good sense of humour

Benefi ts We are committed to ensuring that all of our teaching staff continue to develop themselves professionally and embrace new and innovative approaches to teaching and learning. The successful candidate will teach in our new Senior school campus, which has contemporary, bright teaching spaces equipped with the latest educational technology. The school has a range of additional benefi ts including:
● The opportunity to live and work in a beautiful area with great connections to the rest of Europe
● A safe and secure environment in which to work
● Numerous outdoor activities (particularly as Villars is a renowned ski resort)
● An opportunity to learn or improve your French
● To work in a school with an excellent reputation
● To be part of a growing school with opportunities for advancement
● Attractive working conditions
● Professional development opportunities

Teamlead Microsoft IT Services \- Aufbau Standort Bern
======================================================

Erster Teamlead am neuen EveryWare\-Standort Bern: Team aufbauen, technisch aktiv bleiben, Richtung geben.

Teamlead Microsoft IT Services \- Aufbau Standort Bern
======================================================

Wer braucht deine Verstärkung?
-------------------------------

Deine neue Herausforderung ist bei EveryWare, dem führenden Schweizer Cloud\- und IT\-Service\-Provider mit einer eigenen hochskalierbaren DataCenter\- und Netzwerk\-Infrastruktur in Zürich \- und mit Spezialisierung auf die Bedürfnisse von Businesskunden. Mit mehr als 20 Jahren Expertise konzipiert und betreibt das Unternehmen Private, Public und Hybrid Cloud Architekturen, Hosting und Managed IT\-Plattformen. Rund 250 Mitarbeitende, davon 90% spezialisierte Engineers, bringen internationale Innovationen praktikabel in Schweizer Unternehmen. Über 3000 Unternehmen sowie 30 Businesspartner haben EveryWare bereits als Partner gewählt. Über 200 erfolgreich realisierte Grossprojekte für Businesskunden, darunter auch Kunden aus der Banken\- und Versicherungsbranche, belegen die Kompetenz von EveryWare.



So schaffst du Mehrwert
-----------------------

Bern ist kein Satellitenbüro \- es ist ein vollwertiges Team im Aufbau. Du bist die erste Führungsperson vor Ort, baust dein Team schrittweise auf (2026: 3\-4 Engineers, 2027: 5\-6\) und bist gleichzeitig selbst technisch aktiv. Kein Wasserkopf, keine reine Managementstelle.

Was dich konkret erwartet:

* Du baust das Berner Team schrittweise auf und führst es disziplinarisch und fachlich: 1:1\-Gespräche, Kapazitätsplanung, Entwicklung der Teammitglieder.
* Du arbeitest eng mit den fünf weiteren Teamleads und dem Head Microsoft IT Services zusammen.
* Du betreibst und entwickelst Windows\-Server\-, M365\- und Cloud\-Umgebungen für Kunden aktiv mit.
* Du übernimmst technische Projektleitung bei Migrationen, IT\-Outsourcing und Infrastruktur\-Upgrades.
* Du löst komplexe Probleme im 3rd\-Level\-Support und hältst Architekturbeschreibungen und Runbooks aktuell.
* Du stellst Servicequalität und SLA\-Einhaltung gegenüber Kunden sicher und eskalierst, wenn nötig.


Das zeichnet dich aus
---------------------

Du bist keine Führungskraft, die sich vom Tagesgeschäft abgekoppelt hat. Du weisst noch, wie ein Runbook aussieht und du kannst PowerShell lesen und schreiben. Gleichzeitig weisst du, wie man ein Team aufbaut, ohne es zu mikromanagen.

Was du mitbringst:

* 2\-3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Teamlead\- oder Senior\-Rolle mit Personalverantwortung.
* Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung mit Microsoft\-Umgebungen \- du kennst diese Umgebungen aus dem Betrieb, nicht nur aus der Theorie.
* Fundierte IT\-Infrastruktur\-Kenntnisse: du hast hybride Infrastrukturen aktiv mitgestaltet.
* Strukturierte Kommunikation auf allen Ebenen: Team, Kunden, Management \- auf Deutsch und Englisch, Französisch ein Plus.
* Erfahrung mit Kapazitätsplanung und Priorisierung in einem Managed\-Services\-Umfeld.
* PowerShell\-Kenntnisse und Freude an Automatisierung.




Benefits
--------



### TOP Lage



Dein neuer Arbeitsplatz befindet sich direkt am Hauptbahnhof Bern (Welle 7\) \- öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und unzählige Lunchmöglichkeiten liegen vor der Tür.





### Anspruchsvolle Projekte



Unsere Expertise in Design, Aufbau und Betrieb von führenden Plattformen mit modernsten Cloud\-Technologien spiegelt sich in über 200 erfolgreich umgesetzten Grossprojekten wider.





### Geballtes Know\-how



Technische Begeisterung trifft auf umfassende Expertise. Hier profitierst du von einem reichen Erfahrungsschatz und einem hochprofessionellen Netzwerk.





### Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung



Du findest bei uns ein Arbeitsumfeld, das sich permanent den Anforderungen des Marktes und der Kunden anpasst. Daher erwarten dich viele interne sowie externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.





### Stabilität \& Wachstum



Als Schweizer Unternehmen mit über 20 Jahren Erfolgsgeschichte setzen wir auf Stabilität, Vertrauen und langfristige Beziehungen \- zu Kunden und zu Mitarbeitenden.





### Strukturiertes Onboarding



Ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungsprogramm mit persönlichen Mentoren ermöglicht dir einen reibungslosen Start.

title: Critical Infrastructure Mechanical Engineer, Field Engineering
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Field Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.
* Possess excellent communication and writing skills, attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.
* Organized and have the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines and budget
* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.
* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).
* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.
* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

**Key job responsibilities
**

You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

* Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.
* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

**About the team
**

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.


**Diverse Experiences
**

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


**Work/Life Balance
**

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


**Inclusive Team Culture
**

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.


**Mentorship and Career Growth
**

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken English
* Willing to travel between Data Center sites, and internationally if required
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering or equivalent
* Experience with mission critical facilities engineering including but not limited to the following sectors: data centers, power generation, oil & gas facilities. (Experienced Engineer).
Preferred qualifications
* Possess data analytics skills, data querying skills/language, scripting, and comfort with working in vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments
* Direct experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers.
* Experience as resident engineer or hands-on (in the field) design consultant or owner’s engineer.
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region. Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents.
* Ability to carry design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment/mass production.
* Basic understanding of both mechanical and/or electrical equipment/design related to data centers (Including but not limited to: uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switch gear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, fans, air economizers, water treatment, etc...).
* EPMS/SCADA/BMS Controls system experience (software and/or hardware)
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken German and English
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Gas Turbine Plant Operator
==========================

**Your primary responsibility is to monitor and control the gas turbine power plant systems from the control room, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation. You will identify and respond to operational disturbances, initiate corrective actions, and coordinate with the relevant stakeholders to maintain plant availability and performance.**


**Your tasks**

* Monitor and operate power plant equipment and systems using the Emerson Ovation control system;
* Perform plant start\-up, shutdown, and load adjustment procedures;
* Identify, analyze, and respond to alarms, faults, and operational disturbances;
* Perform and document switching operations in accordance with safety procedures;
* Support emergency response activities during abnormal operating conditions;
* Coordinate activities with Maintenance, Engineering, and external service providers;
* Maintain shift logs, operational records, and incident reports;
* Conduct plant inspections and verify equipment conditions in the field;
* Support maintenance activities, outages, overhauls, and recommissioning;
* Ensure effective shift handovers and compliance with plant procedures and safety regulations.




**Your profile**

title: Strategic Pricing Analyst
description:
About Surgery

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of surgery? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Surgery team will give you the chance to deliver surgical technologies and solutions to surgeons and healthcare professionals around the world. Your contributions will help effectively treat some of the world’s most prevalent conditions such as obesity, cardiovascular disease and cancer. Patients are waiting.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Strategic Pricing Analyst Surgery - Johnson & Johnson
Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare?
We are seeking a Strategic Pricing Analyst to join our commercial team.
This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships, market trends and customer needs.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to advance pricing strategies and new business models, evaluate pricing proposals, and provide guidance on organizational standards related to product performance.
If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in price and margin calculations, you are the candidate we want to hear from.

Roles & responsibilities

Strategic Pricing is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It influences how we will go to market as a Surgery organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. This approach aligns customer expectations with business objectives with the aim to demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.

· In the role as Strategic Pricing Analyst you will report to the Commercial Lead of the Swiss Surgery organization and closely collaborate with the Strategic Account Management, the Operational Pricing, the Sales Organization and the Marketing Team.
· Together with the Strategic Account Management and our clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.
· You will develop data driven pricing-strategies to maximize profitability and competitiveness
· In close collaboration with our Marketing Team you prepare new product launches, go to market models and potential portolio segmentations.
· In conjunction with the Surgery Leadership Team, you will coordinate regular reviews of departmental pricing analysis reports and submit results on a timely basis to the Management for review and subsequents directives.
· Together with the Operational Pricing Team you will analyse current pricing models and structures to identify areas to improve pricing efficiencies for the customer base.

You will define local price-volume guidance and lead the design and testing of new tools to support the local sales force.
To support business plan development and account stretegies you will provide recommendations on alternate pricing models to the Management in order to secure key customer business.

· You will assess and track pricing key performance measures as well as ad hoc analysis and reporting to measure against pricing goals and targets.
· You are the direct link to the EMEA Pricing Team
· Working at Johnson & Johnson implifies understanding and applying of Johnson & Johnson’s Credo and Leadership Imperatives in day-to-day interactions with the team.



Qualifications

Academic or financial background, ideally supported by a Master’s degree in Business Administration with several years of experience in pricing or a comparable role.
Strong understanding of profit and loss statements (P&L), margin analysis, cost structures, and price-demand relationships.
Experience in contracting and deal structuring is a plus.
Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.
Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.
Excellent written and verbal communication in German, strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, along with experience using Power BI and other financial analysis tools; programming skills are an asset, ERP (S4/H) knowledge is a plus.

Drone Assembly Operator
=======================

Fotokite develops autonomous, high\-endurance tethered unmanned aerial systems to help firefighters and public safety teams save lives.

Fotokite systems allow first responders to quickly and easily gain situational awareness after arriving at emergency scenes: our autonomous one\-touch launch/land system makes operation simple and safe; the dual color and thermal camera payload provides situational awareness from the system’s aerial perspective; and actively tethered flight means the system can be flown without a certified pilot, and can be left flying for as long as the situation requires.

The Drone Assembly Operator will work with a team of engineers and other technicians to build the organization’s newest products. This position performs hands\-on assembly of electro\-mechanical sub\-systems and provides input to the engineering team to assist them with developing and refining the manufacturing process of these products for low\-volume, in\-house production and eventual hand\-off to the commercial production line.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assemble complex electro\-mechanical sub\-systems, including testing, troubleshooting, and repair.
* Build products following work instructions and drawings with precision and consistency.
* Troubleshoots issues and communicates them to other technicians and/or the engineering team
* Provides feedback and observations related to the assembly process in the form of red\-lined drawings and written communication
* Maintains an organized workflow and workstation
* Receives and inspects components
* Conducts indoor assembly tests according to established procedures
* Monitors and reports on all aspects that relate to the quality of components and assemblies
* Tracks component inventory as it relates to build schedules
* Performs other duties as assigned


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS**

* High School Diploma or equivalent and 2\+ years of related experience are required
* Ability to assemble complex electro\-mechanical systems using engineering assembly drawings
* Demonstrated keen eye for detail, a technical aptitude, and a desire to learn
* Experience handling ESD\-sensitive components, as well as working in an ESD\-safe environment following ESD\-safety best practices preferred
* Proven record of proactively working to meet production timelines
* Working experience with common spreadsheet and word processing tools, such as G\-Suite and/or MS Office
* Experience working for an international company is a plus
* Fluency in English and German is required, any other language is a plus

title: Data Center Design Manager
description:
**Department:** **Design Group**

**Reports to:** **Project Manager/Construction Manager**

**Responsible for:** **Design Coordination and Development throughout the Project including Coordination of shop drawings**

**Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**

**Start Date:**  

**Employment Type:** **Full time / On Site**

ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Data Center Design Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead coordinated design delivery across the building and its critical systems, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters design and procurement team in Istanbul.

**Data Center Design Manager**

The role combines technical leadership, design delivery management and close support to procurement, construction and commissioning.

***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***

* A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil, or building services engineering, architecture or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional competence
* At least 10 years of relevant design or construction experience, with proven responsibility for leading multidisciplinary design delivery, including detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover
* Strong knowledge of CSA and critical MEP interfaces, power and cooling resilience, and practical construction requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead consultants and specialist designers, manage design deliverables and approvals, and resolve complex interfaces in an international EPC, main contractor or comparable project environment.
* Practical BIM coordination, model review and document control experience, using Navisworks or Solibri, Revit/IFC models and common data environment such as ACC, Aconex or equivalent.
* Commercial and programme awareness, including design scope, procurement interfaces and change control. Sound judgment, clear reporting and the ability to close decisions under construction deadlines.
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.


***Main Duties and Responsibilities***

* Lead civil structural, architectural and MEP design delivery from the current design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, coordinating ENKA’s consultants and specialist designers.
* Work daily with ENKA’s headquarters design team in Istanbul. Lead technical meetings in Turkish and provide daily reports on progress, outstanding decisions, design risks and actions.
* Maintain the design management plan, responsibility matrix, deliverables register and programme. Align releases with procurement lead times, construction sequencing and the integrated project schedule.
* Coordinate excavation, temporary works interfaces, foundations and piling where required, concrete, steel, architecture, façades and roofing with equipment loads, installation sequences and building services.
* Integrate critical power and cooling systems, including utility interfaces, transformers, generators, UPS, distribution, cooling plant, pumps and CRAH/CRAC units, together with controls, fire protection, security and ICT pathways.
* Close interfaces for openings, sleeves, shafts, plinths, embedded items, support and fire stopping before construction release. Coordinate structural approvals, maintenance access and equipment replacement routes.
* Lead multidisciplinary reviews and BIM coordination. Resolve technical and spatial issues, record decisions and maintain controlled models, drawings and specifications in the common data environment.
* Manage consultant scopes, technical submittals, RFIs and review comments. Coordinate approved construction information and track overdue inputs, revisions and approvals.
* Integrate vendor and subcontractor design, including employer supplied equipment where applicable. Coordinate technical procurement inputs, long lead equipment interfaces and vendor changes.
* Coordinate compliance reviews and permit submissions with Swiss consultants, authorities and utilities, addressing applicable SIA standards, fire safety requirements and project obligations.
* Assess changes and value engineering with Commercial and Project Controls teams, identifying effects on cost, programme, resilience, safety and operating performance before approval.

Junior Chief of Staff (a) (80\-100%)
====================================




**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als «Junior Chief of Staff».**




**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine Rolle im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung



**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- z.B. via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die Finger schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst



**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit den beiden Eigentümern und Co\-CEOs von Consult \& Pepper zusammen und erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie ein KMU geführt und weiterentwickelt wird.**  
**Du wirst dabei nicht nur an konzeptionellen und strategischen Themen arbeiten. Zu einem KMU gehören genauso administrative Aufgaben und ganz pragmatische Probleme, die gelöst werden müssen. Genau diese Mischung macht die Rolle aus.**

**Möchtest du Unternehmertum nicht nur aus dem Studium kennen, sondern im Alltag erleben und mitgestalten?**

Dann freuen sich **Dominik und Saia** über deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder deinen Anruf (\+ ).

DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)
=================================




**HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.**

**Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.**




**Deine Herausforderung**

* Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.

* Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.

* Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.

* Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.

* Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.

* Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.

* Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.

* Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.




**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)

* Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab

* Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

* Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.

* In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher




**Möchtest du ein DevOps\-Team von Grund auf mitgestalten und deine Erfahrungen einbringen? Suchst du ein stabiles Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen gehört werden?**

Dann freut sich **Thomas Lüthi** auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder auf deinen Anruf.

title: F1 Embedded Application Software Engineer
description:
Join the FIA and play a key role in developing and monitoring the advanced technologies powering Formula 1.
As an Application Software Engineer within the FIA Technical Department, you will strengthen our in-house embedded software capabilities to implement, monitor, and enforce Formula 1 technical and sporting regulations. You will work on complex multi-system electronics projects requiring seamless integration across control units, sensors, communication networks, and data systems.
Based in Geneva, this new role requires working within a fast-paced, multidisciplinary team and includes trackside travel to Formula 1 events (approximately 12 events per year).

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Embedded application software development
Design, implement, validate, and maintain robust in-house embedded software for key FIA Formula 1 platforms, notably the FIA Standard ECU and Accident Data Recorder, to monitor and enforce regulatory compliance.
Lead end-to-end multi-system integration across control units, sensors, vehicle communication buses, telemetry networks, and FIA data-analysis suites.
Translate complex sporting, technical, and operational requirements into high-integrity software architectures, detailed specifications, and rigorous verification plans.
Develop specialized simulation, test, and data-analysis tools to accelerate software validation, support regulatory evolution, and guarantee operational readiness.
Execute functional and integration testing on bench and vehicle environments in close collaboration with F1 teams, power unit manufacturers, and electronics suppliers.
Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain application software repositories, applying rigorous code reviews, version control, and clear technical documentation to ensure long-term reliability and maintainability.
Build and scale in-house engineering capabilities, reinforcing the FIA’s operational independence and responsiveness to emerging technical demands.

Auditing of electronic systems
Inspect competitors' embedded software, system behaviour, and telemetry data for compliance across chassis and powertrain regulations.
Develop automated auditing tools and liaise with suppliers to streamline electronic inspection and homologation workflows.

Development strategy and regulatory support
Support future regulation updates through proactive simulation, system modeling, and technical validation.
Define specifications for future FIA electronic architectures, safeguard FIA intellectual property, and contribute technical input to F1 working groups.

Race and test support
Provide trackside support at F1 races and tests (~12 events/year) to configure, operate, and monitor FIA electronics and data-logging systems.
Analyse real-time vehicle telemetry to verify regulatory compliance and resolve cross-system software anomalies in collaboration with teams and manufacturers.

PROFILE:
Master’s degree in Electronics, Control Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 to 5 years of professional experience in embedded control systems or real-time application software development within a competitive motorsport environment (Formula 1, Formula E, WEC).
Knowledge of the FIA Formula 1 Standard ECU and its application software tool suite would be a significant advantage.
Proven track record in real-time embedded software development, testing, and lifecycle management; proficiency in MATLAB, Simulink, and Simscape.
Strong understanding of Formula 1 or Formula E or WEC chassis and powertrain operation, including associated electronic, electrical, communication, control and data systems.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex multi-system electronics projects involving the integration and validation of interconnected embedded systems.
Excellent organisational and communication skills, autonomy under pressure, and adaptability to high-tempo trackside environments.
Absolute discretion regarding confidential data; fluent written and spoken English.

title: Senior Specialist, IT
description:
Senior Specialist, IT  
Senior Specialist, IT  
Place of work: Basel, Switzerland  
Employment rate: 50–100%  
Start date: 1 January 2027 or sooner  
Contract type: Permanent  
Other: Must be eligible to work in Switzerland  
Basel Institute on Governance  
The Basel Institute on Governance is a hands\-on centre of competence dedicated to promoting good governance and countering corruption for a more peaceful, just and sustainable world. Established in 2003 in Basel, Switzerland, the Institute works with partners worldwide to advance knowledge, practice and policy on anti\-corruption, asset recovery and business integrity. With field operations worldwide, it has some 150 staff covering 32 nationalities. The Basel Institute is an Associated Institute of the University of Basel.  
Job description  
The Senior Specialist, IT takes operational ownership of the Basel Institute’s IT infrastructure, security and identity management. Working closely with and deputising for the Head, IT and eLearning, the successful candidate will keep the Basel Institute’s systems secure, available and well\-documented, lead the day\-to\-day implementation of the IT Security and Operations Policy and help with the safe and effective adoption of new technologies, including AI. The Senior Specialist will also supervise and develop the Associate, IT.  
Key responsibilities  
Implement, maintain and monitor the Basel Institute’s IT Security and Operations Policy and support the disaster recovery and malware response plans.  
Maintain and monitor the IT infrastructure, including the Sophos firewall appliance, UniFi wireless network, Xerox printers, 3CX phone system, Synology NAS devices and the NextCloud shared drive.  
Manage users, authentication and access rights across Active Directory and Google Workspace, including onboarding and offboarding and regular access reviews.  
Provide and coordinate cybersecurity awareness training for staff, including onboarding and regular refresher training and act as a point of contact for reporting and responding to security incidents.  
Identify, evaluate and implement AI tools and solutions to improve IT operations and support their safe, compliant and well\-governed adoption across the Basel Institute.  
Supervise, mentor and develop the Associate, IT, coordinating day\-to\-day support and workload.  
Oversee IT asset management, backups and system monitoring, coordinate with external service providers and deputise for the Head, IT and eLearning as required.  
Provide first\-level IT support to staff alongside the Associate, IT, ensuring timely resolution and acting as the escalation point for more complex issues.  
Qualifications and skills  
University degree or equivalent vocational qualification in information technology, computer science or a related field.  
At least five years of experience in IT systems administration and infrastructure, ideally in a mixed on\-premises and cloud environment.  
Proven expertise in network and firewall administration (Sophos experience is an advantage), identity and access management (Active Directory, Google Workspace) as well as IT security.  
Relevant experience with UniFi Wi\-Fi, Synology NAS, NextCloud, 3CX telephony and remote management/monitoring tools, as well as experience supervising or mentoring colleagues, is an advantage.  
Proficient in Microsoft and Google Workspace administration.  
Experience in a major AI platform (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and the creation and management of skills, plugins, connectors, agents and MCP servers.  
Languages: Excellent English skills; a good command of German and proficiency in other languages are an advantage.  
Offer  
We offer an interesting and rewarding working environment with a proactive, dynamic and international team spirit. The work is both routine and varied, and offers scope for initiative and innovation. The salary is competitive.
